title.zh: 卷383 列傳一百七十 张文浩 严烺 张井 吴邦庆 栗毓美 麟庆 潘锡恩子：骏文
title.en: Volume 383 Biographies 170: Zhang Wenhao, Yan Lang, Zhang Jing, Wu Bangqing, Li Yu Mei, Lin Qing, Pan Xien son: Jun Wen
title.raw: 卷383 列傳一百七十 张文浩 严烺 张井 吴邦庆 栗毓美 麟庆 潘锡恩子：骏文

sentences.zh: 列傳一百七十

translations.literal: Biographies 170
translations.idiomatic: Biography 170

sentences.zh: 張文浩嚴烺張井吳邦慶栗毓美

translations.literal: Zhang Wenhao, Yan Lang, Zhang Jing, Wu Bangqing, Li Yumei
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenhao, Yan Lang, Zhang Jing, Wu Bangqing, and Li Yumei

sentences.zh: 麟慶潘錫恩子駿文

translations.literal: Lin Qing, Pan Xien, son Junwen
translations.idiomatic: Lin Qing, Pan Xien, and his son Junwen

sentences.zh: 張文浩，順天大興人。

translations.literal: Zhang Wenhao was a native of Daxing in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wenhao came from Daxing in the Shuntian metropolitan district.

sentences.zh: 入貲為布政司經歷，投效東河，工竣，發南河。

translations.literal: He purchased office as a provincial administration commissioner’s secretary, volunteered for service on the Eastern River works, and upon completion of the project was sent to the Southern River.
translations.idiomatic: He bought his way into office as secretary to a provincial administration commissioner, then offered his services on the Eastern River project; when that work was finished he was posted to the Southern River.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十年，授山清外河同知，屢以河溢奪職，尋復之，補外河南岸同知。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Jiaqing he was appointed subprefect of the Outer River at Shanqing; he was repeatedly stripped of office for river overflows but soon restored, and was then made subprefect of the south bank of the Outer River.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of the Jiaqing reign (1805) he was appointed subprefect in charge of the outer Yellow River section at Shanqing. Floods cost him his post more than once, but he was soon reinstated and then assigned as subprefect on the south bank of the outer river.

sentences.zh: 十九年，河督吳璥奏調赴睢工委用，擢署淮海道。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the river commissioner Wu Jin memorialized to transfer him to service at the Sui River works, and he was promoted to acting intendant of Huai-Hai.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year (1814) River Commissioner Wu Jin had him transferred to the Sui River works, and he was promoted to acting intendant of the Huai-Hai circuit.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，河溢儀封，復決武陟馬營壩，調辦馬營壩工，工竣，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the river overflowed at Yifeng and again breached the Maying Dam at Wuzhi; he was transferred to manage the Maying Dam works, and upon completion was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year (1819) flooding at Yifeng broke the Maying Dam at Wuzhi again. Zhang was put in charge of repairing it; when the work was done he received the peacock feather insignia.

sentences.zh: 儀封決口猶未塞，仁宗以吳璥年老，命文浩署河東河道總督，專駐工次。

translations.literal: The breach at Yifeng had still not been closed; Emperor Renzong, considering Wu Jin old, ordered Wenhao to serve as acting governor-general of the Eastern River course and to remain stationed at the works.
translations.idiomatic: The Yifeng breach was still open. Emperor Renzong, finding Wu Jin too old for the task, made Wenhao acting governor-general of the Eastern River and ordered him to stay on site at the works.

sentences.zh: 疏陳築壩挑河估銀四百五十萬，報可。

translations.literal: He memorialized that building dams and dredging the river would cost an estimated 4.5 million taels; the memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial he estimated 4.5 million taels for dam construction and river dredging; the court approved the plan.

sentences.zh: 工竣，晉二品頂戴，​​兼兵部侍郎銜。

translations.literal: When the works were completed he was advanced to a second-rank cap button and concurrently given the nominal rank of vice minister of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: After the project was finished he was promoted to a second-rank cap button and given the concurrent nominal title of vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 道光元年春，欽天監奏彗星出東壁，分野在衛地，占主大水，敕文浩防範。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Daoguang the Directorate of Astronomy reported a comet appearing at the Eastern Wall; its associated region lay in Wei territory, the omen indicating great floods, and Wenhao was ordered to take precautions.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Daoguang 1 (1821) the Directorate of Astronomy reported a comet at the Eastern Wall asterism, whose terrestrial correlate was the Wei region—an omen of major flooding—and the emperor ordered Wenhao to guard against it.

sentences.zh: 侍郎吳烜請加高河堤，文浩疏言：「河灘高下不齊，長堤千餘裡，未能一律增高，請加子堰二三尺。」

translations.literal: Vice Minister Wu Xuan requested raising the river dikes; Wenhao memorialized: "The river flats are uneven in height; along more than a thousand li of main dike it cannot all be raised uniformly—please add subsidiary dikes two or three chi high."
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Wu Xuan proposed raising the river embankments. Wenhao replied in a memorial: "The river flats vary in elevation; along more than a thousand li of main dike a uniform raise is impossible—I ask instead to add subsidiary embankments two or three feet high."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 實授河道總督。

translations.literal: He was then appointed in full capacity as governor-general of river works.
translations.idiomatic: He was then given the substantive post of governor-general of river works.

sentences.zh: 三年，丁母憂，服未闋，以畿輔連年水患，召署工部侍郎，偕三品卿繼昌勘南北運河及永定河漫溢。

translations.literal: In the third year he entered mourning for his mother; before the mourning period had ended, because the capital region had suffered floods year after year, he was summoned to serve as acting vice minister of the Ministry of Works and, together with third-rank secretary Jichang, to survey flooding on the north–south Grand Canal and the Yongding River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1823) he went into mourning for his mother. Before his mourning term ended, repeated flooding in the metropolitan region led the court to appoint him acting vice minister of works and send him with third-rank secretary Jichang to inspect overflows on the north–south Grand Canal and the Yongding River.

sentences.zh: 詔繼昌還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Jichang to return.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Jichang back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 文浩駐工會辦。

translations.literal: Wenhao remained at the works to supervise jointly.
translations.idiomatic: Wenhao stayed on site to oversee the work.

sentences.zh: 工竣，與總督蔣攸銛合疏陳：「直隸河道漫水未涸，無從查勘，考詢各處堤埝，無不堙塞殘廢。

translations.literal: When the works were finished he and Governor-General Jiang Youqian jointly memorialized: "In the Zhili river courses the floodwaters have not yet receded, so inspection is impossible; inquiry at every dike and spur shows them all silted up, ruined, and abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: When the project ended he and Governor-General Jiang Youqian submitted a joint memorial: "Floodwater in the Zhili waterways has not yet drained, so we cannot survey them properly; every dike and spur we have asked about is choked with silt, broken down, or neglected.

sentences.zh: 每年二月方可動工，五月即須停止，工繁時促，斷難同時興作。

translations.literal: Work can begin only in the second month each year and must stop in the fifth; the tasks are many and time short, so it is impossible to undertake them all at once.
translations.idiomatic: Construction can start only in the second month and must halt by the fifth; with so much to do and so little time, we cannot possibly tackle everything at once.

sentences.zh: 請於來歲春融，週曆履勘，分別緩急估辦。」

translations.literal: We ask that when the ice melts next spring a thorough on-site survey be made and projects be estimated according to urgency."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that next spring, once the ice thaws, officials make a full on-site survey and draw up cost estimates ranked by urgency."

sentences.zh: 又言：「永定河為患，固由下口不能暢流，亦由上游無所宣洩。

translations.literal: They also said: "The Yongding River causes trouble not only because its lower mouth cannot discharge freely, but also because the upper reaches have no outlet for release.
translations.idiomatic: They added: "The Yongding River floods not only because the lower outlet cannot run freely, but also because the upper course has nowhere to spill excess water.

sentences.zh: 請修築重門閘，添設減水壩。

translations.literal: We ask to repair and build the Chongmen Sluice and add flood-relief dams.
translations.idiomatic: We propose repairing the Chongmen Sluice and adding flood-relief dams.

sentences.zh: 又近年河流每多側注北岸，宜添築越堤以為重障。」

translations.literal: In recent years the current has often poured against the north bank; outer dikes should be added as a second barrier."
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the current has often struck the north bank; we should build outer dikes as an additional line of defense."

sentences.zh: 四年春，授江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year he was appointed governor-general of the Jiangnan river course.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year (1824) he was made governor-general of the Jiangnan river works.

sentences.zh: 其秋，糧艘回空，黃河高於清水，停阻河北者數月，詔切責，降三品頂戴，命設法蓄清以資浮送。

translations.literal: That autumn the grain barges on the return voyage found the Yellow River higher than the clear water; they were held up north of the river for months. An edict sharply rebuked him, reduced his cap button to third rank, and ordered him to devise means to store clear water for buoying the fleet.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn returning grain barges found the Yellow River higher than the canal’s clear water and were stuck north of the crossing for months. The emperor rebuked him sharply, reduced his cap button to third rank, and ordered him to store enough clear water to float the fleet through.

sentences.zh: 十一月，始全數渡黃。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the entire fleet at last crossed the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Not until the eleventh month did the entire fleet finally cross the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 會洪澤湖漲水未消，高堰十三堡堤潰萬一千餘丈，山盱、周橋、悉浪菴亦過水八九尺，各壩漫溢。

translations.literal: Just then the flood on Hongze Lake had not yet subsided; the dike at the thirteen forts of Gaoyan breached for more than eleven thousand zhang; at Shanxu, Zhouqiao, and Xilang'an the water also ran eight or nine chi deep, and every dam overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile floodwater on Hongze Lake had not yet fallen. The dike at Gaoyan’s thirteen forts burst along more than eleven thousand zhang; at Shanxu, Zhouqiao, and Xilang'an the water stood eight or nine feet deep, and every dam spilled over.

sentences.zh: 宣宗怒，褫文浩職，命尚書文孚、汪廷珍馳勘，劾文浩禦黃壩應閉不閉，五壩應開不開，蓄清過旺，以致潰決。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong was enraged, stripped Wenhao of office, and sent ministers Wen Fu and Wang Tingzhen posthaste to investigate; they impeached Wenhao for keeping the Yellow River control dam closed when it should have been opened and the five dams closed when they should have been opened, storing clear water to excess and thereby causing the breach.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong was furious, removed Wenhao from office, and dispatched Ministers Wen Fu and Wang Tingzhen to investigate on the spot. They impeached him for leaving the Yellow River control dam shut when it should have been opened, keeping the five outlet dams closed when they should have been opened, and hoarding clear water until the embankment gave way.

sentences.zh: 命於工次枷號一月，遣戍新疆。

translations.literal: He was ordered to wear the cangue at the works for one month and was banished to Xinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was made to wear the cangue at the worksite for a month, then exiled to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 回疆軍事起，隨營效力，事平，請釋回，不許。

translations.literal: When military operations began in the Western Regions he served with the army; when peace was restored he petitioned to be released and sent home, but permission was denied.
translations.idiomatic: When fighting broke out in the Western Regions he served with the troops. After peace returned he asked to be released and sent home, but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒於戍所。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died at his place of exile.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year (1836) he died in exile.

sentences.zh: 嚴烺，字小農，浙江仁和人。

translations.literal: Yan Lang, style Xiaonong, was a native of Renhe in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Lang, whose style was Xiaonong, came from Renhe in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶中，入貲為通判，發南河，累擢徐州道，丁母憂。

translations.literal: During the Jiaqing reign he purchased office as subprefect, was sent to the Southern River, and was repeatedly promoted to intendant of Xuzhou; he then entered mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jiaqing he bought office as subprefect and was posted to the Southern River, rising step by step to intendant of Xuzhou before going into mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，服闋，授河南河北道。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, when mourning ended, he was appointed intendant of Henan north of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning ended in Daoguang 1 (1821) he was appointed intendant of the Henan north-bank circuit.

sentences.zh: 尋命以三品頂戴署河東河道總督，三汛安瀾，乃實授。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to serve with a third-rank cap button as acting governor-general of the Eastern River course; after the three flood seasons passed without incident he received the substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made acting governor-general of the Eastern River with a third-rank cap button. After three flood seasons passed without disaster he received the full appointment.

sentences.zh: 汶水漫決既塞，疏言：「運河北路以蓄汶敵衛為最要機宜，必使汶水層層抬高，然後能敵衛水。

translations.literal: After the Wen River overflow had been stopped up, he memorialized: "On the northern route of the Grand Canal the essential strategy is to store Wen River water to counter the Wei River; the Wen must be raised level by level before it can hold back the Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Wen River breach was sealed he wrote: "On the canal’s northern route the key is to impound Wen River water to counter the Wei. The Wen must be raised stage by stage before it can stand against the Wei.

sentences.zh: 請加高臨清口磚閘資收蓄。」

translations.literal: He asked to raise the brick sluice at Linqingkou to aid storage."
translations.idiomatic: He proposed raising the brick sluice at Linqingkou to hold more water back."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 初，黎世序治南河多用碎石，乃奏請敕東河仿行，烺取其說，請於馬營北岸挑壩，仿南河拋護碎石，估工需銀十萬兩。

translations.literal: Earlier Li Shixu in managing the Southern River had used much rubble stone; he memorialized asking that the Eastern River be ordered to follow suit. Lang adopted the proposal and asked to build a spur dike on the north bank at Maying, following the Southern River practice of casting rubble for protection, the works estimated at one hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shixu had long relied on rubble stone on the Southern River and urged the Eastern River to do the same. Lang took up the idea and asked to build a spur dike on the north bank at Maying, casting rubble as on the Southern River, at an estimated cost of one hundred thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 布政使程含章、巡撫姚祖同先後言其不便，而馬營既放淤，壩前水勢已緩，烺仍請於壩尾沁水灌注之所拋護碎石，從之。

translations.literal: The provincial treasurer Cheng Hanzhang and the governor Yao Zutong in succession said it was impractical; but since Maying had already silted up and the current before the dam had eased, Lang still asked to cast rubble where the Qin River poured in at the tail of the dam, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial treasurer Cheng Hanzhang and governor Yao Zutong both objected that the plan was impractical. After Maying had silted up and the current in front of the dam had slackened, Lang still asked to cast rubble at the tail where the Qin River fed in, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 四年，南河高家堰潰決，調烺江南河道總督。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Gaojia Embankment on the Southern River breached; Lang was transferred to be governor-general of the Jiangnan river course.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1824) the Gaojia Embankment on the Southern River burst, and Lang was transferred to governor-general of the Jiangnan river works.

sentences.zh: 五年，與尚書文孚、汪廷珍合疏陳：「蓄清敵黃為河務第一關鍵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he and Ministers Wen Fu and Wang Tingzhen jointly memorialized: "Storing clear water to counter the Yellow River is the first essential of river administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1825) he joined Ministers Wen Fu and Wang Tingzhen in a memorial: "Holding clear water to push back the Yellow River is the single most important principle of river control.

sentences.zh: 蓄清全賴湖堤，堤潰則清水洩枯，重運經臨，無以資浮送。

translations.literal: Storing clear water depends entirely on the lake dikes; if the dikes breach the clear water drains away, and when the main grain transport passes there is nothing to buoy the fleet.
translations.idiomatic: Clear water depends entirely on the lake embankments. Once they break the lake drains dry, and when the grain fleet arrives there is no water left to float the barges.

sentences.zh: 擬遵古人成法，借黃濟運。

translations.literal: We propose to follow the ancient established method of using Yellow River water to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: We propose to follow the old practice of borrowing Yellow River water to serve the canal.

sentences.zh: 所慮運河窄小，黃流湍悍，多則不能容納，少則必致膠淺。

translations.literal: Our concern is that the canal is narrow, while the Yellow current is swift and fierce: too much water cannot be contained, too little will surely cause shoaling.
translations.idiomatic: The canal is narrow and the Yellow current fierce—too much water will not fit, too little will leave the channel shoaled and unnavigable.

sentences.zh: 議於禦黃壩外建壩三道，鉗束黃流，俾有節制。

translations.literal: It is proposed to build three dams outside the Yellow River control dam to clamp the current and give it regulation.
translations.idiomatic: We propose building three dams outside the Yellow River control dam to pinch the current and keep it under control.

sentences.zh: 又添築纖道，以資束水行纖。

translations.literal: Towpaths are also to be added to help confine the water for tracking.
translations.idiomatic: We would also build towpaths to confine the water and allow tracking.

sentences.zh: 裡、揚兩廳長河挑挖淤淺，幫培堤身，並豫儲料物，隨時築壩，逼溜刷淤。

translations.literal: The long canal sections under the Li and Yang bureaus are to be dredged of silt shoals, the dikes strengthened, materials stored in advance, and dams built as needed to force the current and scour silt.
translations.idiomatic: On the long canal reaches under the Li and Yang offices we would dredge shoals, strengthen the dikes, stock materials in advance, and build temporary dams whenever needed to drive the current and scour silt away.

sentences.zh: 禦黃壩未啟，則先挑高堰引河，導清水入運；

translations.literal: Before the Yellow River control dam is opened, the Gaoyan diversion channel is to be dredged first to lead clear water into the canal;
translations.idiomatic: Before the Yellow River control dam opens, we would first dredge the Gaoyan diversion to send clear water into the canal;

sentences.zh: 將啟，則嚴堵束清，杜黃水入湖。

translations.literal: when it is about to open, clear water is to be tightly blocked off to shut Yellow River water out of the lake.
translations.idiomatic: and just before opening it we would seal off the clear water tightly to keep Yellow River water out of the lake.

sentences.zh: 至修復湖堤，必乘天寒水涸，取土較易。

translations.literal: As for repairing the lake dikes, work must take advantage of cold weather when the water is low, when earth is easier to obtain.
translations.idiomatic: Lake embankments must be repaired in cold weather when the water is low and earth easier to dig.

sentences.zh: 擬就近採料，限大汛前砌高十層，備湖水漸長。

translations.literal: Materials are to be gathered nearby, with a deadline before the great flood season to raise the masonry ten courses high against the gradual rise of the lake.
translations.idiomatic: We would gather materials nearby and, before the main flood season, raise the masonry ten courses high in readiness for the lake’s rise.

sentences.zh: 共需帑銀三百萬。」

translations.literal: The total required from the treasury is three million taels."
translations.idiomatic: The whole plan would cost three million taels from the treasury."

sentences.zh: 又議覆侍郎硃士彥條上南河事宜，大要：「拆修高家堰壩工，先築越壩以便工作，並於石堤外拋碎石坦坡，可期永無塌卸。

translations.literal: They also replied to Vice Minister Zhu Shiyan’s items on Southern River affairs, in sum: "In dismantling and repairing the Gaojia Embankment works, first build an outer dam to facilitate labor, and cast a rubble stone slope outside the stone dike, so that collapse may be expected never to occur.
translations.idiomatic: They also answered Vice Minister Zhu Shiyan’s proposals on the Southern River, in brief: "When rebuilding the Gaojia Embankment, build an outer dam first to give workers footing, and cast a rubble slope outside the stone dike so the structure need never collapse again.

sentences.zh: 又於王家壩減壩內鹽河加築堤埽，及仁、義、禮舊壩處所添建石滾壩，以防異漲。」

translations.literal: Dikes and revetments are also to be added on the salt river within the Wangjiaba flood-relief dam, and stone roller dams built at the old Ren, Yi, and Li dam sites to guard against abnormal rises."
translations.idiomatic: We would also strengthen dikes and revetments on the salt river inside the Wangjiaba relief dam and add stone roller dams at the old Ren, Yi, and Li dam sites to guard against sudden surges."

sentences.zh: 並如議行。

translations.literal: All was carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved and carried out the plan.

sentences.zh: 於是偕孫玉庭等會辦重運。

translations.literal: Thereupon he joined Sun Yuting and others in jointly managing the main grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: He then worked with Sun Yuting and others to oversee the main grain transport.

sentences.zh: 至五月禦黃壩啟放後，河道仍淺滯，漕船不能通行，就近盤壩，剝運難繼，玉庭被重譴，烺亦鐫級留任。

translations.literal: By the fifth month, after the Yellow River control dam had been opened, the channel was still shallow and sluggish; grain barges could not pass; transshipment at nearby dams was hard to sustain; Yuting was heavily punished, and Lang was also demoted several ranks but retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth month, even after the Yellow River control dam opened, the channel remained shallow and slow and grain barges still could not get through. Transshipment at nearby dams could not keep pace. Yuting was severely punished, and Lang was demoted several ranks but kept in his post.

sentences.zh: 烺既因濟運事不敢擅離，不能巡河勘工，兩江總督琦善以為言，乃命烺週曆履勘，仍諭蓄足清水，為來年敵黃濟運之計。

translations.literal: Because Lang, occupied with aiding transport, dared not leave on his own and could not tour the river to inspect works, Governor-General Qishan of the Two Jiangs spoke of this; Lang was then ordered to make a thorough on-site survey, while still being instructed to store sufficient clear water for next year’s plan of countering the Yellow River and aiding transport.
translations.idiomatic: Lang could not leave the transport crisis to tour the works, and Governor-General Qishan of the Two Jiangs complained. The court ordered him to make a full inspection tour while still telling him to store enough clear water for next year’s plan to use it against the Yellow River and float the grain fleet.

sentences.zh: 烺疏言：「從前黃河底深，湖水收至數尺，即可外注，堤身不甚吃重。

translations.literal: Lang memorialized: "Formerly the Yellow River bed was deep; when the lake water was stored to several chi it could be released outward, and the dikes did not bear great strain.
translations.idiomatic: Lang wrote: "In the past the Yellow River bed was deep. A few feet of stored lake water was enough to pour out and scour it, and the dikes did not bear much pressure.

sentences.zh: 今則湖水必蓄至二丈，始可建瓴而刷黃。

translations.literal: Now the lake water must be stored to two zhang before it can pour down like a rooftop torrent and scour the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: Today the lake must be held to two zhang before the water can pour down with enough force to scour the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 以四百里浩瀚之湖水，恃一線單堤為之護，西風衝擊，勢必潰決。

translations.literal: To protect four hundred li of vast lake water with a single narrow dike—when the west wind strikes, breach is inevitable.
translations.idiomatic: Four hundred li of open lake water cannot safely rest behind a single narrow dike; a west wind will surely burst it.

sentences.zh: 擬仿成法，於堤外築碎石坦坡，護堤既固，則湖水可蓄。」

translations.literal: We propose to follow established practice and build a rubble stone slope outside the dike; once the dike is secured, the lake water can be stored."
translations.idiomatic: We propose the established remedy of a rubble slope outside the dike. Once the embankment is secure, the lake can hold water again."

sentences.zh: 又偕琦善奏陳：「刷黃必須湖水收至二丈。

translations.literal: He also joined Qishan in memorializing: "Scouring the Yellow River requires lake water stored to two zhang.
translations.idiomatic: He and Qishan added in a memorial: "Scouring the Yellow River requires two zhang of lake water.

sentences.zh: 上年楜​​水丈七寸餘，即致失事。

translations.literal: Last year the lake water stood only one zhang seven chi and more, and disaster followed at once.
translations.idiomatic: Last year the lake stood barely one zhang seven chi, and disaster followed immediately.

sentences.zh: 刻下清水萬難蓄足，惟有蓄清減黃二法並行。

translations.literal: At present clear water can hardly be stored in full; only by pursuing together the two methods of storing clear water and reducing the Yellow River can success be hoped for.
translations.idiomatic: At present we can hardly store enough clear water; we must pursue both storing clear water and reducing the Yellow River at once.

sentences.zh: 碎石護堤，所以蓄清；

translations.literal: Rubble stone protects the dikes in order to store clear water;
translations.idiomatic: Rubble slopes protect the dikes so we can store clear water;

sentences.zh: 改移海口，所以減黃。」

translations.literal: relocating the river mouth is the means to reduce the Yellow River."
translations.idiomatic: relocating the river mouth is how we reduce the Yellow River’s force."

sentences.zh: 詔妥籌具奏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered careful planning and a detailed memorial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a thorough plan submitted in writing.

sentences.zh: 尋又會陳：「由王營減壩至灌河口，可導黃入海。

translations.literal: Soon afterward they jointly reported: "From the Wangying flood-relief dam to the Guanhe mouth, the Yellow River can be led to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they reported jointly: "From the Wangying relief dam to the Guanhe estuary the Yellow River could be guided to the sea.

sentences.zh: 查灌河口外海灘高仰，轉無把握，惟拋碎石坦坡，可漸收蓄清刷黃之益，需費六百餘萬，應分年辦理。」

translations.literal: Investigation shows the seashore outside Guanhe mouth rises high and offers no assurance; only casting rubble slopes can gradually secure the benefits of storing clear water and scouring the Yellow River; the cost exceeds six million taels and should be carried out over several years."
translations.idiomatic: But the seashore beyond Guanhe mouth slopes upward, which makes that route uncertain. Only rubble slopes can gradually restore the benefits of storing clear water and scouring the Yellow River. The cost would exceed six million taels and should be spread over several years."

sentences.zh: 六年，洪湖石工既竣，烺知工未堅固，實不足恃，遂堅主碎石之工，每年拋石三十萬方，八年始能告成。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the stone works on Hongze Lake were finished; Lang knew the work was not solid and could not truly be relied on, yet he still firmly advocated rubble stone works, casting three hundred thousand cubic feet of stone each year; only in the eighth year could they be declared complete.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1826) the Hongze Lake stonework was finished. Lang knew it was not sound enough to trust, yet he still pushed rubble stone works, casting three hundred thousand cubic feet of stone a year until the eighth year, when the project was declared done.

sentences.zh: 宣宗怒斥：「烺調任以來，一籌莫展。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong angrily rebuked him: "Since Lang was transferred he has accomplished nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong lashed out: "Since Lang took this post he has achieved nothing.

sentences.zh: 禦黃壩至今不能啟放，辦理不善。

translations.literal: The Yellow River control dam still cannot be opened to this day; his management has been poor.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River control dam still cannot be opened. His management has been poor.

sentences.zh: 念在東河修守尚無貽誤，降三品頂戴。」

translations.literal: Considering that on the Eastern River his repair and defense had not yet caused disaster, his cap button was reduced to third rank."
translations.idiomatic: Remembering that his work on the Eastern River had not yet failed outright, the court reduced his cap button to third rank."

sentences.zh: 署河東河道總督；

translations.literal: He was made acting governor-general of the Eastern River course;
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed acting governor-general of the Eastern River;

sentences.zh: 七年，實授，复二品頂戴。

translations.literal: in the seventh year he received the substantive appointment and again the second-rank cap button.
translations.idiomatic: in the seventh year (1827) he received the full appointment and regained his second-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 以蘭陽柴壩西北頂沖，前拋碎石已著成效，遇伏秋汛漲，仍形吃重，請加寬坦坡。

translations.literal: Because the northwest crown of the Lanyang timber dam was under direct attack, the rubble previously cast had shown effect, but during the summer and autumn flood rise it was still under strain; he asked to widen the slope.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest crown of the Lanyang timber dam was taking the main current. Earlier rubble casting had helped, but the summer and autumn floods still strained the site, and he asked to widen the slope.

sentences.zh: 八年，請續拋下北、蘭儀兩廳碎石，並於中河、祥河險工儲石備防。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he asked to continue casting rubble in the Xiabei and Lanyi bureaus and to stock stone at dangerous works on the Middle and Xiang rivers against emergencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1828) he asked to keep casting rubble in the Xiabei and Lanyi offices and to stock stone at critical points on the Middle and Xiang rivers for emergencies.

sentences.zh: 十一年，命侍郎鍾昌等抽查東河料垛，祥河、曹考兩廳料垛虛松殘朽，烺坐失察，降三品頂戴，鐫四級留任。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Vice Minister Zhong Chang and others were ordered to inspect Eastern River material stockpiles; those of the Xianghe and Cao-Kao bureaus were hollow, loose, and rotten; Lang was punished for lack of supervision, reduced to a third-rank cap button, and demoted four ranks while retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year (1831) Vice Minister Zhong Chang inspected Eastern River material piles and found those at Xianghe and Cao-Kao hollow, loose, and rotten. Lang was faulted for poor oversight, reduced to a third-rank cap button, and demoted four ranks but kept in post.

sentences.zh: 尋以病請開缺。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, on grounds of illness, he asked to be relieved of office.
translations.idiomatic: He soon asked to resign on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 十三年，病痊到京，疏陳浙江海塘事宜。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, recovered from illness, he came to the capital and memorialized on Zhejiang seawall affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1833), recovered and back in the capital, he memorialized on Zhejiang’s seawalls.

sentences.zh: 十四年，命偕侍郎趙盛奎往勘，請分別緩急，改修柴埽，以護塘根，歲撥銀五萬備修費，從之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was ordered to go with Vice Minister Zhao Shengkui to survey; he asked that priorities be distinguished, timber revetments be rebuilt to protect the foot of the seawall, and fifty thousand taels be allocated yearly for repairs; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1834) he was sent with Vice Minister Zhao Shengkui to inspect the coast. He asked that work be ranked by urgency, timber revetments rebuilt to protect the seawall foot, and fifty thousand taels set aside each year for repairs. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 尋命毋庸在工督辦。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered not to remain on site supervising the works.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon told he need not stay on site to supervise.

sentences.zh: 復以病乞歸。

translations.literal: Again, on grounds of illness, he asked to return home.
translations.idiomatic: He again asked to go home on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 十五年，河東河道總督吳邦慶劾烺虛拋碎石，並收受紅封盤費，以運同降補。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Eastern River governor-general Wu Bangqing impeached Lang for falsely reporting rubble cast and for receiving red-seal gratuities and entertainment fees; he was demoted to transport subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1835) Eastern River governor-general Wu Bangqing accused Lang of padding rubble reports and taking red-seal gifts and entertainment fees. He was demoted to transport subprefect.

sentences.zh: 二十年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1840) he died.

sentences.zh: 張井，字芥航，陝西膚施人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jing, style Jiehang, was a native of Fushi in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jing, whose style was Jiehang, came from Fushi in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶六年進士，以內閣中書用，改知縣，銓授廣東樂會。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the sixth year of Jiaqing, was employed as a Secretariat drafter, was transferred to magistrate, and by selection was appointed to Lehui in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in Jiaqing 6 (1801), served as a Secretariat drafter, then became a magistrate and was assigned to Lehui in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 引見，特命改河南正陽，調祥符，遷許州直隸州知州。

translations.literal: On presentation at court he was specially ordered transferred to Zhengyang in Henan, then to Xiangfu, and promoted to magistrate of Xuzhou direct prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At his audience the emperor specially reassigned him to Zhengyang in Henan, then to Xiangfu, and later made him magistrate of Xuzhou direct prefecture.

sentences.zh: 襄辦馬營壩大工，加知府銜，署汝寧知府。

translations.literal: He assisted in the great works at the Maying Dam, was given the nominal rank of prefect, and served as acting prefect of Runing.
translations.idiomatic: He helped manage the major Maying Dam project, received the nominal rank of prefect, and served as acting prefect of Runing.

sentences.zh: 道光四年，擢開歸陳許道。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Daoguang he was promoted to intendant of Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 4 (1824) he was promoted to intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit.

sentences.zh: 尋以三品頂戴署河東河道總督。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to serve with a third-rank cap button as acting governor-general of the Eastern River course.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made acting governor-general of the Eastern River with a third-rank cap button.

sentences.zh: 五年，秋汛安瀾，乃實授。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the autumn flood season passed safely, and he then received the substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1825), after the autumn floods passed without incident, he received the full appointment.

sentences.zh: 增培黃河兩岸堤工，並修泉河堤，濬各湖斗門引渠，疏陳河工久遠大計，略曰：「今日之黃河，有防無治。

translations.literal: He strengthened dikes on both banks of the Yellow River, repaired the Quan River dikes, and dredged sluice channels from the various lakes; in a memorial on the long-term plan for river works he said in summary: "Today’s Yellow River has defense but no real control.
translations.idiomatic: He raised the Yellow River dikes on both banks, repaired the Quan River embankments, and dredged lake outlet channels. In a memorial on long-term river policy he wrote, in brief: "Today’s Yellow River is only defended, not truly governed.

sentences.zh: 每遇伏秋大汛，司河各官奔走搶救，竭蹶情形，惟日不足。

translations.literal: Whenever the great summer and autumn floods come, every river official rushes about in emergency rescue, exhausted day after day with never enough time.
translations.idiomatic: Every summer and autumn flood season river officials rush from crisis to crisis, exhausted day after day with never enough time.

sentences.zh: 及至水落霜清，則以目前可保無虞，不復求疏刷河身之策。

translations.literal: When the water falls and frost clears, they decide the present moment is safe and no longer seek policies to dredge and scour the river channel.
translations.idiomatic: Once the water falls and frost sets in, they decide the river is safe for now and stop looking for ways to dredge and scour the channel.

sentences.zh: 漸致河底墊高，清水不能暢出，並誤漕運。

translations.literal: This gradually raises the riverbed, clear water cannot flow out freely, and grain transport is also harmed.
translations.idiomatic: The bed rises, clear water cannot run out freely, and the grain transport suffers as well.

sentences.zh: 又增盤壩起剝及海運等費，皆數十年來斤斤於築堤鑲埽，以防為治，而未深求治之之要有以致之也。

translations.literal: Added costs for transshipment dams, lighterage, and sea transport—all stem from decades of scrupulous dike-building and revetment work, treating defense as control without deeply seeking the essentials of real control, which has brought this about.
translations.idiomatic: Transshipment, lighterage, and sea transport added further costs—all because for decades officials have poured effort into dikes and revetments, treating flood defense as river control without ever grasping what real control requires.

sentences.zh: 當此河底未能疏濬之時，惟仍守舊規，以堤束水，而水不能攻沙，河身日形淤墊，必得有刷深之方，始可遂就下之性。」

translations.literal: While the riverbed cannot yet be dredged, we can only follow old rules and use dikes to confine the water; yet the water cannot attack sand, the channel daily silts higher, and only with a method to scour it deep can the river’s downward nature be restored."
translations.idiomatic: Until the bed can be dredged we are stuck with the old rule of confining water behind dikes. That water cannot scour sand, so the channel silts higher every day. Only a way to scour it deep can restore the river’s natural downward flow."

sentences.zh: 宣宗韙其言，命偕兩江總督琦善、南河總督嚴烺、河南巡撫程祖洛籌議，遂赴南河會勘。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong approved his words and ordered him to deliberate with Governor-General Qishan of the Two Jiangs, Governor-General Yan Lang of the Southern River, and Governor Cheng Zuluo of Henan; he then went to the Southern River for a joint survey.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor endorsed his view and told him to plan with Governor-General Qishan, Southern River governor-general Yan Lang, and Henan governor Cheng Zuluo. He then went south for a joint inspection.

sentences.zh: 六年，疏言：「黃河病在中滿，淤墊過甚，自應因勢利導。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he memorialized: "The Yellow River’s ailment lies in its raised middle and excessive silt buildup; we should guide it according to its natural tendency.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he wrote: "The Yellow River is sick because its middle is too high and silt too deep. We must guide it where the terrain allows.

sentences.zh: 擬仿前大學士阿桂改河避險之法，導使繞越高淤，於安東東門之北別築新堤，以北堤改作南堤，中間抽挑引河，傍舊河而行。

translations.literal: We propose to follow the method of the former grand secretary Agui in changing the river course to avoid danger, guiding it around the high silt bar, building a new dike north of Andong’s east gate, converting the north dike into a south dike, and dredging a diversion channel between them alongside the old river.
translations.idiomatic: Following Grand Secretary Agui’s old method of shifting the channel to avoid danger, we would route the river around the high silt bar, build a new dike north of Andong’s east gate, turn the north dike into the south dike, and dredge a diversion between them parallel to the old course.

sentences.zh: 至絲網濱以下，仍歸海口，無淤灘阻隔，似可暢順東趨。

translations.literal: From Siwangbin downward it would still reach the sea mouth, with no silt bars blocking it, and could flow smoothly eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Below Siwangbin it would rejoin the estuary without silt bars in the way and could run smoothly east to the sea.

sentences.zh: 去路既暢，上淤必掣深，得黃與清平，立啟禦黃壩，挑逼清水暢出刷黃，自有建瓴之勢。」

translations.literal: Once the outlet is clear, upstream silt will be drawn down; when Yellow and clear water are level, open the Yellow River control dam at once, dredge to force clear water out and scour the Yellow River, and the torrent will naturally pour down from the rooftop."
translations.idiomatic: A clear outlet would draw down upstream silt. Once Yellow and clear water stood level, we could open the control dam, force clear water out, and scour the Yellow River with rooftop force."

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其有識，調江南河道總督，與總督琦善及副總河潘錫恩會議。

translations.literal: An edict praised his insight, transferred him to governor-general of the Jiangnan river course, and ordered conferences with Governor-General Qishan and vice commissioner Pan Xien.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his insight, made him Jiangnan river governor-general, and ordered him to confer with Qishan and vice commissioner Pan Xien.

sentences.zh: 以改河避淤，口門有碎石阻遏，諸多窒礙，請開放王營減壩，以期減落黃水，刷滌河身，從之。

translations.literal: Because changing the river to avoid silt met rubble obstruction at the mouth and many hindrances, he asked to open the Wangying flood-relief dam in hope of lowering Yellow River water and scouring the channel; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Shifting the channel to avoid silt ran into rubble at the mouth and other obstacles, so he asked to open the Wangying relief dam to lower the Yellow River and scour the bed. The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 既而給事中楊煊奏「啟放減壩，黃流湍急，鹽河勢難容納，恐滋流弊」，援嘉慶間減壩兩次漫口情形為證。

translations.literal: Soon afterward supervising secretary Yang Xuan memorialized that opening the relief dam would send a swift Yellow current the salt river could hardly contain and might breed abuses, citing the two overflows at the relief dam during Jiaqing as proof.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary Yang Xuan then warned that opening the relief dam would pour a fierce Yellow current the salt river could not hold and invite abuse, pointing to two Jiaqing-era overflows as proof.

sentences.zh: 復下詳議，井言：「煊稽考成案，於今昔情形似未周知。

translations.literal: Again the case was sent down for detailed deliberation, and Jing said: "Xuan has examined precedents, but seems not fully acquainted with conditions past and present.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered another full review. Zhang Jing replied that Yang Xuan had searched the records but did not seem to grasp how things differed then and now.

sentences.zh: 昔年開壩漫口時在五月，本年啟放定在霜後，來源無慮續漲。

translations.literal: In former years overflow came when the dam was opened in the fifth month; this year opening is fixed for after frost, and the upstream flow need not be feared to keep rising.
translations.idiomatic: Past overflows had happened when the dam opened in May. This year it would open only after frost, so upstream flows were unlikely to keep surging.

sentences.zh: 惟現據委員禀稱，去路未見通暢，是煊所奏不為無見。

translations.literal: Only now commissioners report that the outlet has not yet been seen to run clear, so Xuan's memorial is not without point.
translations.idiomatic: Yet commissioners now reported the outlet still blocked, so Yang Xuan was not entirely wrong.

sentences.zh: 因思啟壩時水勢或可暢達，堵合後全河仍必抬高，恐徒深四邑之災，無補全河之病。

translations.literal: I reflect that when the dam opens the current may run freely, but after it is closed the whole river will still have to rise; I fear this would only deepen disaster in the four districts without curing the whole river's malady.
translations.idiomatic: Opening might ease the flow for a time, but once the breach was sealed the whole channel would rise again. That would deepen the suffering in four counties while leaving the river's root sickness untouched.

sentences.zh: 請仍改河避淤。」

translations.literal: I ask that we still change the river course to avoid silt buildup."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that we return to shifting the channel to avoid silt."

sentences.zh: 上斥井持論游移，不許。

translations.literal: The emperor rebuked Jing's views as vacillating and would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor called Zhang Jing's position wavering and rejected it.

sentences.zh: 是秋，開放減壩，如期堵合，被褒獎。

translations.literal: That autumn the relief dam was opened and, closed on schedule, he received commendation.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the relief dam opened and closed on schedule, and he was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 七年，春汛，黃水倒漾，仍高於清水，禦壩驟難啟放，漕船倒塘灌運，自請治罪，降三品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, during the spring flood, Yellow River water backed up and still stood higher than clear water; the control dam suddenly could not be opened, and grain boats drew water from ponds for transport. He asked to be punished and was demoted to a third-grade official's button.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year spring floods sent Yellow water backing up above the clear channel, and the control dam could not be opened in time. Grain boats had to haul water from ponds to keep moving. He asked to be punished and was stripped to third-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 命大學士蔣攸銛、尚書穆彰阿往勘。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Jiang Youqian and Minister Mu Zhang'a were ordered to go and inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Jiang Youqian and Minister Mu Zhang'a were sent to inspect.

sentences.zh: 會黃水低落，啟禦壩，運船幸得全渡，詔斥井急於求功，泥於師古，革職留任，以觀後效。

translations.literal: Just then Yellow water fell; the control dam was opened and transport boats fortunately all crossed. An edict rebuked Jing for rushing to claim merit and clinging blindly to antique methods, removed him from office but kept him in his post to await later results.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow water then fell, the control dam opened, and the fleet barely got through. The court scolded Zhang Jing for chasing credit and clinging to old models, stripped him of rank but left him in post to prove himself.

sentences.zh: 八年，疏陳要工四事：黃河接築海口長堤，並於下游多築埽壩以資刷掣；

translations.literal: In the eighth year he memorialized four major works: continuing the sea-mouth long dike on the Yellow River and building many revetment dams downstream to aid scouring and drawing down;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he proposed four main projects: extend the Yellow River's sea-mouth dike and build more revetment dams downstream to scour and draw silt;

sentences.zh: 洪澤湖添建滾壩，加寬湖堤；

translations.literal: adding rolling dams on Hongze Lake and widening the lake dikes;
translations.idiomatic: add rolling dams on Hongze Lake and widen its dikes;

sentences.zh: 南運河移建昭關壩，加幫兩岸纖堤；

translations.literal: relocating the Zhaoguan dam on the Southern Grand Canal and bolstering the tow-path dikes on both banks;
translations.idiomatic: relocate the Zhaoguan dam on the Southern Grand Canal and strengthen both tow-path dikes;

sentences.zh: 北運河修復劉老澗石滾壩，補還南岸纖堤。

translations.literal: and on the Northern Grand Canal restoring the stone rolling dam at Liulaojian and repairing the south bank tow-path dike.
translations.idiomatic: and on the Northern Grand Canal restore the stone rolling dam at Liulaojian and repair the south bank tow-path dike.

sentences.zh: 命都統英和會同蔣攸銛查勘，以添築埽壩不能疏通積淤，海口築堤可從緩辦，餘如議行。

translations.literal: Dutong Yinghe was ordered to inspect jointly with Jiang Youqian; because added revetment dams could not clear accumulated silt, the sea-mouth dike might be deferred, and the rest was approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Yinghe and Jiang Youqian were told to inspect. Extra revetments would not clear the built-up silt, so the sea-mouth dike could wait; the rest would proceed as planned.

sentences.zh: 九年，以兩屆安瀾，复二品頂戴，​​諭相機規复河湖舊制。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, for two successive years without flood calamity, his second-grade button was restored, and he was instructed to seize the moment and restore the old river-and-lake system.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, after two calm seasons, he regained second-rank insignia and was told to restore the old river and lake regime when conditions allowed.

sentences.zh: 疏言：「南河利害，全系清江，必清水暢出，助黃刷淤，則河與漕兩治。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "The gains and losses of the Southern River all hinge on Qingjiang; clear water must flow out freely to help scour Yellow River silt, and then both river and transport are cured.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote: "The Southern River's fate hangs on Qingjiang. Only if clear water runs out freely and scours Yellow silt can both the river and the grain route be saved.

sentences.zh: 惟黃水積淤，必清高於黃數尺，又必啟壩​​時多、閉壩時少，乃能暢出滌刷。

translations.literal: Only because Yellow water silts up, clear water must stand several chi higher than Yellow, and the dam must be opened often and closed seldom, before it can flow out freely and scour.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow silt meant clear water had to stand several chi higher, and the dam had to stay open longer than it stayed shut, before the current could scour freely.

sentences.zh: 現在清水能出，僅免倒灌，不誤漕行，殊未易收刷滌之效。」

translations.literal: At present clear water can get out only enough to avert backflow and not delay transport; it is far from easy to achieve scouring and washing."
translations.idiomatic: Clear water now escaped only enough to stop backflow and keep grain moving; real scouring was still out of reach."

sentences.zh: 十二年，桃源縣民聚眾私掘官堤掣溜，致成決口，革職，暫留任效力。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Taoyuan county people gathered and privately dug the official dike to draw off the current, causing a breach; he was removed from office but temporarily kept in his post to serve.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year crowds in Taoyuan secretly dug the official dike to bleed the current and caused a breach. He was dismissed but kept on temporarily to serve out his duty.

sentences.zh: 御史鮑文淳、宗人府府丞潘錫恩並言黃水入湖，恐妨運道，命穆彰阿、陶澍會勘籌議。

translations.literal: Censor Bao Wenchun and vice director of the Imperial Clan Court Pan Xien both said Yellow water entering the lake might obstruct the transport route; Mu Zhang'a and Tao Shu were ordered to inspect jointly and deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Bao Wenchun and Imperial Clan vice director Pan Xien warned that Yellow water in the lake could block the canal. Mu Zhang'a and Tao Shu were sent to inspect and plan.

sentences.zh: 疏陳：「黃水入湖後，即由吳城七堡仍入黃河，僅淤沿堤，不及湖中，未入束清壩，不致病及運河。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "After Yellow water enters the lake it returns to the Yellow River by way of Wucheng's seven forts; it only silts along the dikes and does not reach into the lake body, nor enter the Shuqing dam, so it need not harm the Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: He argued that once Yellow water entered the lake it rejoined the Yellow River through Wucheng's seven forts, silting only the dikes and not the lake itself or the Shuqing dam, so the canal would not suffer.

sentences.zh: 正河乾涸，正可將桃南、桃北兩廳間大加挑濬，除去中滿之患。」

translations.literal: The main channel is dry; we can greatly dredge between the Taonan and Taobei offices and remove the raised-middle ailment."
translations.idiomatic: With the main channel dry, we could dredge heavily between the Taonan and Taobei offices and cure the raised bed."

sentences.zh: 十三年，於家灣合龍，予四品頂戴。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the breach at Yujiawan was closed and he was granted a fourth-grade button.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the Yujiawan breach was sealed and he received fourth-rank insignia.

sentences.zh: 尋引疾歸。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he cited illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: He soon pleaded illness and went home.

sentences.zh: 十五年，卒於家。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: He died at home in the fifteenth year.

sentences.zh: 井任兩河凡十年。

translations.literal: Jing served in charge of both river systems for ten years in all.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jing oversaw both river systems for ten years in all.

sentences.zh: 初治南河，銳意任事，洎興大工，糜帑三百餘萬而無成效，仍為補苴之計，用灌塘法，較勝借黃之險。

translations.literal: When he first governed the Southern River he was keen to take responsibility; but when major works were undertaken more than three million taels of treasury funds were spent without effect. He still had to resort to patching; using the pond-irrigation method was safer than the risk of borrowing Yellow water.
translations.idiomatic: He began on the Southern River with fierce energy, but major works swallowed more than three million taels without real gain. He fell back on stopgaps; pond irrigation for transport was safer than drawing on the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 勤於修守，世稱其亞於黎世序云。

translations.literal: Diligent in repair and defense, his contemporaries ranked him next after Li Shixu.
translations.idiomatic: Diligent in upkeep, his peers ranked him just below Li Shixu.

sentences.zh: 吳邦慶，字霽峰，順天霸州人。

translations.literal: Wu Bangqing, style Jifeng, was a native of Bazhou in Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bangqing, styled Jifeng, came from Bazhou in Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 以拔貢官昌黎訓導。

translations.literal: As a selected tribute graduate he served as instructor at Changli.
translations.idiomatic: A tribute graduate, he served as instructor at Changli.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，成進士，選庶吉士，授編修，遷御史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed compiler, and transferred to censor.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he passed the jinshi, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, became a compiler, and moved to the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 巡視東漕，奏請重浚運河，並復山東春兌春開舊制。

translations.literal: Inspecting Eastern grain transport, he memorialized to dredge the Grand Canal again and restore Shandong's old spring exchange and spring opening system.
translations.idiomatic: While inspecting eastern grain transport he asked to re-dredge the canal and restore Shandong's old spring exchange and spring opening rules.

sentences.zh: 數論河漕事，多被採用。

translations.literal: He often discussed river and transport affairs, and many of his proposals were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: He spoke often on rivers and transport, and much of what he said was taken up.

sentences.zh: 十九年，擢鴻臚寺少卿，命偕內閣學士穆彰阿督濬北運河。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he was promoted to vice minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments and ordered with Grand Secretariat bachelor Mu Zhang'a to supervise dredging of the Northern Grand Canal.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he rose to vice minister of Honglu Temple and was paired with Mu Zhang'a to oversee dredging of the Northern Grand Canal.

sentences.zh: 累遷內閣侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He was promoted in sequence to Grand Secretariat reader.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to become a Grand Secretariat reader.

sentences.zh: 二十年，出為山西布政使，調河南，護理巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he went out as fiscal commissioner of Shanxi, was transferred to Henan, and acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he became Shanxi fiscal commissioner, moved to Henan, and served as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，擢湖南巡撫，調福建，未之任，湘潭土客民群鬥，死傷甚眾。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was promoted to governor of Hunan and transferred to Fujian; before he took office, natives and settlers in Xiangtan fought in crowds and many were killed or wounded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was made Hunan governor and reassigned to Fujian, but before he took up the post natives and settlers in Xiangtan rioted and many were killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 侍郎週系英面陳與邦慶疏奏有異，命總督慶保往按。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Zhou Xiying stated in person that his account differed from Bangqing's memorial; Governor Qingbao was ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Zhou Xiying told the throne that his account differed from Bangqing's memorial, and Governor Qingbao was sent to investigate.

sentences.zh: 邦慶亦發系英私書，系英獲譴；

translations.literal: Bangqing also disclosed Xiying's private letters, and Xiying was punished;
translations.idiomatic: Bangqing also leaked Xiying's private letters, and Xiying was censured;

sentences.zh: 邦慶鐫級，以三品京堂用，補通政使。

translations.literal: Bangqing was reduced in rank, appointed as a third-grade capital official, and made chief of the Office of Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: Bangqing was demoted to third rank, given a capital post, and made chief of transmission.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，擢兵部侍郎，調刑部，尋授安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was promoted to vice minister of War, transferred to Justice, and soon appointed governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he became vice minister of War, moved to Justice, and soon took charge as Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 黃水注淮，鳳、潁被災，而皖南苦旱，親赴災區賑撫。

translations.literal: Yellow water poured into the Huai, Feng and Ying were stricken, while southern Anhui suffered drought; he personally went to the disaster areas to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow water flooded the Huai, Feng and Ying suffered, and southern Anhui baked in drought. He went in person to the stricken districts to relieve them.

sentences.zh: 涇縣民徐飛瀧傷斃，邦慶誤聽承審官謂由於徐孝芳捏傷圖賴，奏捕之，激眾拒捕。

translations.literal: A man of Jing county, Xu Feilong, died of wounds; Bangqing wrongly believed the trial officer that Xu Xiaofang had fabricated wounds to extort payment, memorialized to arrest him, and provoked the crowd to resist arrest.
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Feilong of Jing county died of his wounds, Bangqing wrongly believed the investigating officer that Xu Xiaofang had faked his injuries to extort money. He ordered an arrest, and the crowd rose to resist.

sentences.zh: 命兩江總督孫玉庭鞫治，得其狀，詔斥邦慶幾釀冤獄，部議革職，予編修。

translations.literal: Governor-General Sun Yuting of the Two Jiangs was ordered to try the case and establish the facts. An edict rebuked Bangqing for nearly causing a wrongful conviction; the ministry recommended removal from office and appointment as compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Sun Yuting was told to try the case and learned the truth. The court scolded Bangqing for nearly framing an innocent man; the ministry wanted him dismissed, but he was given a compiler post instead.

sentences.zh: 累遷少詹事。

translations.literal: He was promoted in sequence to junior tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to junior tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 道光十年，授貴州按察使，未之任，予三品卿銜，署漕運總督，尋實授。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Daoguang he was appointed judicial commissioner of Guizhou; before taking office he was given a third-grade minister's rank, acted as governor-general of Grain Transport, and soon received full appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 10 he was named Guizhou judicial commissioner, but before he could take the post he received third-rank minister rank, served as acting grain-transport governor-general, and was confirmed in the post.

sentences.zh: 禁糧船裝載蘆鹽，請緝拿沿河窩頓。

translations.literal: He forbade grain boats to carry reed salt and asked to hunt down hoarding dens along the river.
translations.idiomatic: He banned grain boats from hauling reed salt and asked for raids on riverside hoarding dens.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調江西巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to governor of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 十二年，授河東河道總督，以不諳河務辭，不許。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was appointed governor-general of the Eastern River course; citing unfamiliarity with river affairs he declined, but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made Eastern River governor-general. He pleaded ignorance of river work and was refused.

sentences.zh: 初，嚴烺在東河，多用碎石拋護，歷年歲料未有節省，詔飭覈減。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Yan Lang was on the Eastern River he relied heavily on rubble revetment; for years the annual materials budget had never been reduced, and an edict ordered verification and cuts.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, as Eastern River chief Yan Lang had leaned on rubble revetments; year after year the materials budget never shrank, until the throne ordered a review and cuts.

sentences.zh: 邦慶疏請：「酌改舊章，每年防料經費四成辦稭，六成辦石。

translations.literal: Bangqing memorialized: "We should adjust the old regulations so that each year forty percent of flood-defense material funds go to straw and sixty percent to stone.
translations.idiomatic: Bangqing proposed: "Revise the old rules so forty percent of annual defense funds buy straw and sixty percent buy stone.

sentences.zh: 蘭儀、商虞、下北三廳現工險要，仍專案請辦碎石。

translations.literal: The Lanyi, Shangyu, and Xiabei offices, where works are now critical, should still be handled by special petitions for rubble.
translations.idiomatic: The Lanyi, Shangyu, and Xiabei offices, where the work is most dangerous, should still get rubble by special petition.

sentences.zh: 所議六成之石，積儲數年，使各廳皆存二千，方緩急可恃，則專案之石亦可逐年遞減。」

translations.literal: The stone under the sixty-percent share should be stockpiled over several years until each office holds two thousand; only then can emergencies be relied on, and special rubble petitions can be reduced year by year."
translations.idiomatic: Stockpile the sixty-percent stone over several years until each office holds two thousand units; then emergencies will be covered and special rubble orders can taper off."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 武陟攔黃堰民築民修，嗣歸廳管，工段歲增。

translations.literal: The Wuzhi Yellow River blocking weir had been built and maintained by local people; afterward it came under bureau management, and work sections increased each year.
translations.idiomatic: Locals had built and kept up the Wuzhi Yellow River blocking weir; later it passed to bureau control and the managed stretches grew every year.

sentences.zh: 十三年，奏定畫界立石，官民分守，如有新生埽工，先借帑辦理，按河北三府攤徵歸款。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he memorialized to fix boundaries and set markers, with officials and commoners guarding separately; should new revetment work arise, funds would be borrowed first and repaid by assessment across the three prefectures north of the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he set boundaries with marker stones, split upkeep between officials and locals, and ruled that new revetments would be funded on loan and repaid by levy across the three Hebei prefectures.

sentences.zh: 以山東運河全賴泉源灌注，請復設泉河通判，以專責成。

translations.literal: Because the Shandong canal wholly relies on spring sources for irrigation, he asked to restore the Quanhe intendant post to hold sole responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong canal depended entirely on spring water, so he asked to restore the Quanhe intendant to hold sole responsibility.

sentences.zh: 壽東汛滾水壩外舊有土堰，為蓄汶敵衛，以利漕運，大水鄉民私開釀事，奏立志椿。

translations.literal: Outside the rolling flood dam at the Shoudong station there was formerly an earth weir to store Wen water and guard transport; in heavy floods villagers privately opened it and caused trouble, so he memorialized to set permanent boundary stakes.
translations.idiomatic: Below the Shoudong rolling dam stood an old earth weir that stored Wen water to protect transport. In big floods villagers opened it illegally and trouble followed, so he asked for fixed boundary stakes.

sentences.zh: 濟運之水以七尺為度，重運過竣，啟堰以利農田，如議行。

translations.literal: Water for transport was to be measured at seven chi; after heavy grain transport was finished the weir was to be opened to benefit farmland, and this was approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: Transport water would be held to seven chi; once the heavy grain fleet passed, the weir would open for farmland. The plan was approved.

sentences.zh: 初，邦慶著畿輔水利叢書，後在官，考河南通省志乘所載有水田處，臚列其水之衰旺，溉田多寡之數，為渠田說。

translations.literal: Earlier Bangqing had written the Water Conservancy Series of the Capital Region; later in office he consulted the gazetteers of Henan province for places with irrigated fields, set out the rise and fall of their water and the acreage irrigated, and wrote an essay on canal fields.
translations.idiomatic: Bangqing had once published a water-conservancy series on the capital region. In office he mined Henan's provincial gazetteers for irrigated districts, listed how their water rose and fell and how much land they watered, and wrote a treatise on canal fields.

sentences.zh: 修防之暇，率道廳捐貲造水車，就馬營壩北及蔡家樓大窪積水地七千餘畝試行墾治。

translations.literal: In intervals from repair work he led the circuit and bureaus to donate funds and build water wheels, and on more than seven thousand mu of pooled land north of Maying dam and at Caijialou hollow tried reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Between repair duties he had the circuit and bureaus fund water wheels and trial reclamation on more than seven thousand mu of flooded land north of Maying dam and at Caijialou hollow.

sentences.zh: 先是，邦慶因碎石工劾嚴烺，罷之。

translations.literal: Earlier Bangqing had impeached Yan Lang over rubble works and had him removed.
translations.idiomatic: Bangqing had earlier impeached Yan Lang over rubble works and got him dismissed.

sentences.zh: 既而給事中金應麟亦劾邦慶保舉過濫，動撥過多，十五年，命大學士文孚、山東巡撫鍾祥按之，坐違例調地方人員改歸河工，及以屬員為幕僚，廳員饋銀不奏參，褫職。

translations.literal: Later supervising secretary Jin Yinglin also impeached Bangqing for excessive recommendations and too many fund transfers; in the fifteenth year Grand Secretary Wen Fu and Shandong governor Zhong Xiang were ordered to investigate. He was found guilty of improperly transferring local personnel to river work, using subordinates as private secretaries, and failing to memorialize when bureau officials gave silver gifts, and was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising secretary Jin Yinglin then accused Bangqing of reckless promotions and excessive fund draws. In the fifteenth year Wen Fu and Shandong governor Zhong Xiang investigated. He was found to have improperly redirected local staff to river work, used subordinates as private secretaries, and ignored bureau officials' gift silver. He was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 詔复斥其參劾嚴烺遲至三年之久，亦屬取巧，念在任三屆安瀾，加恩复予編修。

translations.literal: An edict also rebuked him for waiting three years before impeaching Yan Lang as an opportunistic trick, but in consideration of three terms without flood calamity during his tenure, grace restored him to compiler.
translations.idiomatic: The edict also scolded him for waiting three years to impeach Yan Lang, calling it a cheap trick, but granted him compiler rank again for three calm seasons in office.

sentences.zh: 年已七十，遂告歸。

translations.literal: He was already seventy and then requested to return home.
translations.idiomatic: At seventy he retired.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-eighth year.

sentences.zh: 栗毓美，字樸園，山西渾源人。

translations.literal: Li Yumei, style Puyuan, was a native of Hunyuan in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yumei, styled Puyuan, came from Hunyuan in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶中，以拔貢考授佑縣，發河南。

translations.literal: During Jiaqing, as a selected tribute graduate he was appointed to You county by examination and was dispatched to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jiaqing he passed the tribute examination for an appointment to You county and was posted to Henan.

sentences.zh: 歷署溫、孟、安陽、河內、西華，補寧陵，所至著績。

translations.literal: He served in succession as acting magistrate of Wen, Meng, Anyang, Henei, and Xihua, was appointed to Ningling, and distinguished himself wherever he went.
translations.idiomatic: He acted as magistrate in Wen, Meng, Anyang, Henei, and Xihua, then took Ningling, and made a mark everywhere he served.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸，道光初，服闋，補武陟。

translations.literal: He returned home for his father's mourning; in early Daoguang, when mourning ended, he was appointed to Wuzhi.
translations.idiomatic: He went home for his father's mourning. In early Daoguang, when the mourning ended, he was posted to Wuzhi.

sentences.zh: 遷光州直隸州知州，擢汝寧知府，調開封。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Guangzhou direct prefecture, promoted to prefect of Runing, and transferred to Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He became prefect of Guangzhou, rose to Runing prefect, and moved to Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 歷糧鹽道、開歸陳許道、湖北按察使、河南布政使，護理巡撫。

translations.literal: He served successively as grain-and-salt intendant, Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu intendant, judicial commissioner of Hubei, and fiscal commissioner of Henan, and acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: He served as grain-and-salt intendant, Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu intendant, Hubei judicial commissioner, and Henan fiscal commissioner, and acted as governor.

sentences.zh: 十五年，擢河東河道總督。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was promoted to governor-general of the Eastern River course.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he became Eastern River governor-general.

sentences.zh: 毓美自為令時，於黃、沁堤工，馬營壩工皆親其事，勤求河務。

translations.literal: Since his days as magistrate, in Yellow and Qin dike works and Maying dam works Yumei had personally taken part and diligently pursued river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Even as a county magistrate he had handled Yellow and Qin dike work and the Maying dam himself, and kept at river affairs with fierce diligence.

sentences.zh: 時串溝久為河患，串溝者，在堤河之間，始僅斷港積水，久而溝首受河，又久而溝尾入河，於是串溝遂成支河，而遠堤十餘里之河變為切近堤身，往往潰堤。

translations.literal: At the time serial gullies had long been a river affliction. A serial gully lies between dike and river: at first only a broken inlet pooling water; in time its head receives river water, and in more time its tail enters the river; thus the gully becomes a branch stream, and a river once more than ten li from the dike becomes one hugging the dike, often breaching it.
translations.idiomatic: Serial gullies had long plagued the river. These cut channels between dike and mainstream began as stagnant pools, then took river water at the head and fed back at the tail until they became branch streams. Rivers once ten li from the dike drew near the embankment and often burst through.

sentences.zh: 毓美蒞任，乘小舟週曆南北兩岸，時北岸原武汛串溝受水已三百丈，行四十餘裡，至陽武，溝尾复灌入大河；

translations.literal: When Yumei took office he rode a small boat to tour both north and south banks. At that time on the north bank at the Yuanwu station the serial gully receiving water was already three hundred zhang wide, running more than forty li to Yangwu, where the gully tail again poured back into the great river;
translations.idiomatic: On taking office Yumei toured both banks by small boat. On the north bank at Yuanwu station a serial gully already took three hundred zhang of water, ran more than forty li to Yangwu, and poured back into the main channel;

sentences.zh: 又合沁河及武陟、滎澤諸灘水畢注堤下。

translations.literal: It also combined Qin River and the shoal waters of Wuzhi, Rongze, and the rest, all pouring under the dike.
translations.idiomatic: Qin River water and floods from the Wuzhi and Rongze shoals all poured against the dike base.

sentences.zh: 兩汛素無工無稭，石堤南北皆水，不能取土築壩。

translations.literal: Both stations customarily had no works materials or straw; stone dikes had water on north and south and earth could not be taken to build dams.
translations.idiomatic: Neither station had materials or straw on hand, and water on both sides of the stone dikes left no dry ground to build earth dams.

sentences.zh: 毓美乃收買民磚，拋成磚壩數十所。

translations.literal: Yumei then purchased folk bricks and cast them into several dozen brick dams.
translations.idiomatic: Yumei bought up local bricks and built several dozen brick dams.

sentences.zh: 工甫就而風雨大至，支河首尾皆決數十丈而堤不傷，於是始知磚之可用。

translations.literal: The works were just finished when wind and rain came in force; the branch stream breached dozens of zhang at head and tail yet the dike was unharmed, and only then was it known that brick could serve.
translations.idiomatic: The work had barely finished when storms hit. The branch stream tore open dozens of zhang at both ends, yet the dike held, and brick dams proved their worth.

sentences.zh: 疏陳辦理情形，以圖說進。

translations.literal: He memorialized the handling of the situation and submitted explanatory illustrations.
translations.idiomatic: He reported what he had done and submitted illustrated plans.

sentences.zh: 尋又疏言：「王屋莊進水之口，較前更寬百餘丈，由中泓大灘益向南淤，溜勢南緩而北緊。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized again: "The intake at Wangwuzhuang is more than a hundred zhang wider than before; the central deep channel's great shoal silts further south, and the current runs more slowly in the south and more tightly in the north.
translations.idiomatic: He soon wrote again: "The intake at Wangwuzhuang is more than a hundred zhang wider than before. The main shoal keeps silting southward, so the current slackens in the south and runs harder in the north.

sentences.zh: 南股正河成為迂道，北股之溜勢轉建瓴。

translations.literal: The south branch's main channel has become a detour, while the north branch's current turns torrential like water from a rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: The south branch of the main channel had become a backwater, while the north branch poured like water off a rooftop.

sentences.zh: 其故由廣武山前老灘坍千餘丈，溜趨山根，為山所遏，折回東北，中泓挺生淤灘。

translations.literal: The reason is that more than a thousand zhang of old shoal before Guangwu Mountain collapsed; the current rushed toward the mountain foot, was blocked by the mountain, bent back northeast, and a silt shoal rose up in the central deep channel.
translations.idiomatic: Old shoals a thousand zhang wide in front of Guangwu Mountain had collapsed. The current ran to the mountain base, hit the slope, bent back northeast, and a new shoal rose in the main channel.

sentences.zh: 水口既日見刷寬，從省估計，約需銀十餘萬兩。

translations.literal: Since the water mouth is daily seen to scour wider, a frugal estimate requires about more than one hundred thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The inlet was scouring wider every day; a lean estimate put the cost at more than one hundred thousand taels.

sentences.zh: 至原陽兩岸堤根，因沿陂試拋磚塊，深資偎護。

translations.literal: As for the dike foot on both banks at Yuanyang, trial casting of brick blocks along the slope gave deep protective support.
translations.idiomatic: Along the Yuanyang dikes on both banks, brick blocks cast along the slope gave the toe solid protection.

sentences.zh: 月石壩堵合，加高幫寬，迤下楊村、封丘二汛，灘水已停淤，壩下七十餘村莊居民安堵。

translations.literal: The Yueshi dam was sealed, raised, and widened; down along the Yangcun and Fengqiu stations shoal water had stopped silting, and more than seventy villages below the dam lived in peace.
translations.idiomatic: The Yueshi dam was closed, raised, and widened. Downstream at Yangcun and Fengqiu shoals had stopped building up, and more than seventy villages below the dam lived in safety.

sentences.zh: 惟串溝分溜，關係北岸全局，不能緩至來年興工，已借撥銀兩估辦。」

translations.literal: Only the serial gully's split current concerns the whole north-bank situation; work cannot be deferred to next year, and silver has already been borrowed and allocated for estimation and execution."
translations.idiomatic: But the serial gullies splitting the current touched the whole north bank and could not wait until next year; funds had already been borrowed and earmarked for the work."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 是役支河危險，賴磚工化險為平。

translations.literal: This operation on the branch stream was dangerous; thanks to brick works, danger was turned to safety.
translations.idiomatic: That branch-stream project was perilous; brick works alone turned the crisis into a stable channel.

sentences.zh: 尋偕巡撫桂良勘奏：「老河分溜已有六分，王屋莊口寬勢順，磚土各壩未可深恃。

translations.literal: Soon he joined Governor Gui Liang in an inspection memorial: "The old river's split flow already amounts to six-tenths. The Wangwuzhuang mouth is wide and the current favorable; neither brick nor earth dams can be deeply relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: He soon inspected with Governor Gui Liang and reported: "Six-tenths of the flow already splits through the old channel. Wangwuzhuang mouth is wide and the current runs smoothly, but neither brick nor earth dams can be trusted for long.

sentences.zh: 原武十六堡當其頂沖，並有秦家廠、鹽店莊各灘水串溝分注，十七堡當支河尾閭皆險要，請購料豫防。」

translations.literal: Yuanwu's sixteen forts bear the brunt of the impact, and at Qinjiachang and Yandianzhuang shoal water also pours in through serial gullies; the seventeen forts at the branch stream tail are all critical— we ask to purchase materials for advance prevention."
translations.idiomatic: Yuanwu's sixteen forts take the full force of the current, while shoal water at Qinjiachang and Yandianzhuang feeds in through serial gullies. All seventeen forts at the branch stream tail are critical points; we ask to buy materials now and guard against trouble before it comes."

sentences.zh: 如議行。

translations.literal: All was carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved and carried out the plan.

sentences.zh: 十六年，擇要挑濬修築魚台汛堤岸，改民堰歸運河廳。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, key points were selected for dredging and building the Yutai station dikes and banks, and private weirs were transferred to the Grand Canal office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he dredged and rebuilt critical sections of the Yutai station embankments and placed private weirs under the Grand Canal bureau.

sentences.zh: 十八年，旱，漕艘阻滯。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year there was drought, and grain barges were held up.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year drought stalled the grain fleet.

sentences.zh: 濬泉源及各湖進水渠道，嚴諸閘啟閉。

translations.literal: Spring sources and intake channels to the various lakes were dredged, and sluice opening and closing was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: He dredged spring sources and lake inflow channels and tightened control over every sluice gate.

sentences.zh: 又濬曹州、濟寧河渠。

translations.literal: The canal channels at Caozhou and Jining were also dredged.
translations.idiomatic: He also dredged the Caozhou and Jining canal reaches.

sentences.zh: 十九年，奏定微山湖收納運水章程，但計水存丈三尺以內，即築壩蓄水，加高戴村壩以防旁洩。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he memorialized regulations for Weishan Lake receiving transport water: so long as stored water remained within one zhang three chi, dams would be built to hold water and Daicun Dam raised to guard against lateral leakage.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he set rules for Weishan Lake holding transport water: whenever storage stayed within one zhang three chi, dams would be built to impound it and Daicun Dam raised to stop side leakage.

sentences.zh: 初，毓美以磚工屢著成效，奏請許設窯燒造。

translations.literal: At first, because brick works had repeatedly shown results, Yumei memorialized asking permission to establish kilns for manufacture.
translations.idiomatic: Early on, with brick works proving their worth again and again, Yumei asked permission to set up official kilns.

sentences.zh: 御史李蓴疏言其不便，命尚書敬徵往勘，仍請改辦碎石，停止設窯。

translations.literal: Censor Li Chun memorialized that this was inconvenient; Minister Jing Zheng was ordered to inspect on site and still asked to switch to rubble stone and stop establishing kilns.
