translations.idiomatic: Censor Li Chun objected that the plan was impractical. Minister Jing Zheng was sent to inspect and still recommended switching to rubble stone and shutting down the kilns.

sentences.zh: 毓美上疏爭之曰：「豫省歷次失事，皆在無工處所。

translations.literal: Yumei submitted a memorial disputing this, saying: "Each failure in Henan has occurred at unworked sites.
translations.idiomatic: Yumei answered in a memorial: "Every breach in Henan has come at stretches with no permanent works.

sentences.zh: 堤長千里，未能處處籌備。

translations.literal: The dike runs a thousand li; we cannot prepare everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: The embankment runs a thousand li, and we cannot fortify every foot of it.

sentences.zh: 一旦河勢變遷，驟遇風雨，輒倉皇失措。

translations.literal: Once the river regime shifts and wind and rain strike suddenly, men are thrown into panic.
translations.idiomatic: When the river suddenly changes course and storms hit, crews are left scrambling.

sentences.zh: 幸而搶護平穩，埽工費已不貲。

translations.literal: If emergency defense succeeds and things settle, fascine work already costs boundless sums.
translations.idiomatic: Even when emergency repairs hold and the line stabilizes, fascine work already devours enormous sums.

sentences.zh: 鑲埽引溜生工，久為河工所戒，昧者轉謂非此別無良策。

translations.literal: Inset fascines that draw the current deeper and spawn new works have long been warned against in river engineering; the ignorant declare there is no other good plan.
translations.idiomatic: Drawing the current with inset fascines and thereby creating new critical points has long been taboo among river engineers, yet the uninformed insist there is no other remedy.

sentences.zh: 查北岸為運道所關，往者原陽分溜，幾掣動全河，若非用磚拋護，費何可數計？

translations.literal: The north bank concerns the transport route. Formerly when Yuanyang split the flow it nearly pulled the whole river— had brick not been cast for protection, what expense could be counted?
translations.idiomatic: The north bank carries the transport route. When Yuanyang once split the current it nearly dragged the whole river with it; without brick cast for protection, the cost would have been beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 今祥符下汛、陳留一汛灘水串注，堤根形勢，正與北岸同。

translations.literal: Now at the Xiafu station below Xiangfu and the Chenliu station, shoal water serially pours in; the situation at the dike foot is exactly like the north bank.
translations.idiomatic: Today at Xiangfu lower station and Chenliu station shoal water pours in through serial gullies, and the toe of the dike faces the same danger as on the north bank.

sentences.zh: 濱河士民多有呈請用磚者，誠有見於磚工得力，為保田廬情至切也。

translations.literal: Many riverside gentry and commoners have petitioned to use brick— they truly see brick works are effective and are deeply earnest in protecting fields and homes.
translations.idiomatic: Riverside gentry and commoners have petitioned repeatedly for brick, having seen how well it works and how urgently they need to protect fields and homes.

sentences.zh: 夫事之有利於民者，斷無不利於國。

translations.literal: What benefits the people cannot fail to benefit the state.
translations.idiomatic: What truly helps the people cannot fail to help the state.

sentences.zh: 特事近於創，難免浮言。

translations.literal: Only because the measure is nearly novel, idle talk is hard to avoid.
translations.idiomatic: Because the method is still new, gossip is inevitable.

sentences.zh: 前南河用石之始，眾議紛如，良由工程平穩，用料減少，販戶不能居奇。

translations.literal: When the Southern River first used stone, opinion was clamorous— precisely because the works ran smoothly and materials were reduced, suppliers could not gouge prices.
translations.idiomatic: When the Southern River first turned to stone, critics were loud— mainly because steady works and lower material use kept suppliers from cornering the market.

sentences.zh: 工簡務閒，遊客幕友不能幫辦謀生，是以妄生浮議，賴聖明獨斷，敕下東河試辦，至今永慶平成。

translations.literal: Works simplified and business slack; itinerants and staff could not earn by assisting, so empty talk arose. Thanks to the sage emperor's sole decision ordering trial on the Eastern River, Yongqing has been secure ever since.
translations.idiomatic: With simpler works and less busywork, travelers and clerks lost side income from the project, and rumor flourished. Only the emperor's firm order to trial the method on the Eastern River brought Yongqing lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 惟自用碎石，請銀幾七十餘萬，嗣改辦六成碎石，然因購石不易，埽段愈深愈多，經費仍未能節省。

translations.literal: Yet since using rubble stone alone, nearly seven hundred thousand taels were requested; later it was changed to sixty percent rubble, but because stone was hard to procure, fascine sections grew ever deeper and more numerous and funds still could not be saved.
translations.idiomatic: Since relying on rubble stone alone, requests had run to nearly seven hundred thousand taels; even after cutting the mix to sixty percent rubble, stone remained hard to buy, fascine sections grew deeper and longer, and costs still could not be trimmed.

sentences.zh: 自試辦磚壩，三年未生一新工，較前三年節省銀三十六萬。

translations.literal: Since trial brick dams, in three years no new critical work arose; compared with the prior three years, three hundred sixty thousand taels were saved.
translations.idiomatic: After trial brick dams, no new emergency works arose in three years, and three hundred sixty thousand taels were saved compared with the previous three.

sentences.zh: 蓋豫省情形與江南不同，產石祗濟源、鞏縣，採運維艱。

translations.literal: Henan's conditions differ from Jiangnan; stone is produced only at Jiyuan and Gongxian— mining and transport are extremely difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Henan is not Jiangnan: stone comes only from Jiyuan and Gongxian, and getting it out and hauling it is painfully hard.

sentences.zh: 磚則沿河民窯不下數十座，隨地隨時無誤事機。

translations.literal: Brick kilns run by folk along the river number no fewer than several dozen; on the spot, on time, with no missed opportunity.
translations.idiomatic: Along the river private kilns number several dozen at least, so brick can be supplied on the spot and on schedule without missing the moment.

sentences.zh: 且石性滑，入水流轉，磚性澀，入土即黏，卸成坦坡，自能挑溜。

translations.literal: Stone is slippery— in water it rolls; brick is grippy— in earth it sticks. Cast into a gentle slope it naturally draws off the current.
translations.idiomatic: Stone is slick and rolls in the current; brick is rough and grips the soil. Cast as a gentle slope it naturally pulls the main stream away.

sentences.zh: 每方磚塊直六兩，石價則五六兩至十餘兩不等。

translations.literal: Each square of brick blocks costs six taels; stone runs from five or six taels to more than ten, not uniform.
translations.idiomatic: A square of brick blocks costs six taels, while stone ranges from five or six taels to more than ten.

sentences.zh: 碎石大小不一，堆垛半屬空虛。

translations.literal: Rubble stones vary in size; half a stack is hollow air.
translations.idiomatic: Rubble comes in uneven sizes, and half of any pile is empty space.

sentences.zh: 尺磚千塊為一方，平鋪計數，堆垛均實。

translations.literal: A thousand one-foot bricks make one square; laid flat and counted, stacks are solid throughout.
translations.idiomatic: One thousand one-foot bricks make a square; laid flat and counted, the pile is solid all the way through.

sentences.zh: 每方石重五六千斤，而磚重九十餘斤，是一方石價購磚兩方，而拋磚一方可當石兩方之用也。

translations.literal: Each square of stone weighs five or six thousand jin, while brick weighs ninety-odd jin— a square of stone's price buys two squares of brick, and one square of cast brick does the work of two squares of stone.
translations.idiomatic: A square of stone weighs five or six thousand jin against ninety-odd jin for brick: one square of stone money buys two squares of brick, and one square of cast brick does the work of two squares of stone.

sentences.zh: 或謂磚塊入土易損裂，不知磚得水更堅，拋成磚壩，一經淤泥，即已凝結；

translations.literal: Some say brick blocks crack easily in soil, not knowing brick grows harder with water; cast into a brick dam, once silt settles they set solid;
translations.idiomatic: Some claim brick cracks once buried, not knowing it hardens in water; cast into a brick dam and packed with silt, it sets like rock;

sentences.zh: 或謂拋築磚壩，近於與水爭地，不知堤前之地，尺寸在所必爭。

translations.literal: Some say casting brick dams nearly wrests land from the water— not knowing that land before the dike, inch by inch, must be contested.
translations.idiomatic: Others say brick dams mean fighting the river for every inch of ground— yet inch by inch before the dike is ground we must win.

sentences.zh: 自來鑲埽之法，堤前必先築土壩數十丈，然後用埽鑲，設磚壩則無須乎埽。

translations.literal: In the usual fascine-revetting method, dozens of zhang of earth dam must first be built before the dike, then fascines inset; with a brick dam, fascines are unnecessary.
translations.idiomatic: The old fascine method required dozens of zhang of earth dam in front of the dike before inset fascines could go in; a brick dam needs no fascines at all.

sentences.zh: 師土壩之意，不泥其法，拋作坦坡，大溜自然外移，未有可築土壩而不可築磚壩者。

translations.literal: Following the idea of an earth dam without rigidly binding to the method, cast a gentle slope and the main current naturally shifts outward— wherever an earth dam can be built, a brick dam can be built.
translations.idiomatic: Take the principle of the earth dam without copying every step: cast a gentle slope and the main current moves outward by itself. Anywhere an earth dam can stand, a brick dam can stand.

sentences.zh: 上年盛漲，較二年及十二年尤猛迅，磚壩均屹立不移。

translations.literal: Last year's great rise was fiercer even than the second and twelfth years; brick dams all stood unmoved.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's flood ran harder even than those of the second and twelfth years, yet every brick dam held firm.

sentences.zh: 儀睢、中河兩廳，河水下卸，塌灘匯壩，搶鑲埽段，旋即走失，用磚拋護，均能穩定。

translations.literal: At the Yisui and Zhonghe offices, as river water unloaded, banks collapsed and shoals piled into dams; emergency fascine sections were lost at once, but brick cast for protection kept all stable.
translations.idiomatic: At the Yisui and Zhonghe bureaus, as the river unloaded silt, banks caved in and shoals piled up. Emergency fascine sections washed away immediately, but brick casting held the line.

sentences.zh: 是用磚搶辦險工，較鑲埽更為便捷。

translations.literal: Thus using brick for emergency critical works is more expedient than fascine revetting.
translations.idiomatic: Using brick to rush critical repairs is faster and surer than inset fascines.

sentences.zh: 昔衡工失事，因灘陷不能鑲埽；

translations.literal: Formerly the Heng works failed because shoal collapse prevented fascine revetting;
translations.idiomatic: The Heng works failed when the shoal sank too far to inset fascines;

sentences.zh: 馬工失事，因補堤不能得碎石。

translations.literal: the Ma works failed because dike repair could obtain no rubble stone.
translations.idiomatic: the Ma works failed because repairs could not get rubble stone in time.

sentences.zh: 使知用埽不如用磚，運磚易於運石，則費省而工已固。

translations.literal: Had they known fascines are inferior to brick and hauling brick easier than hauling stone, expense would have been saved and the works made solid.
translations.idiomatic: Had they understood that fascines are weaker than brick and brick easier to haul than stone, they would have spent less and built something that lasted.

sentences.zh: 現在各廳無工之處，串溝隱患，必應未雨綢繆。

translations.literal: Now at each office's unworked spots, serial-gully hazards must be foreseen before rain.
translations.idiomatic: Today every bureau still has unprotected stretches where serial gullies lurk; we must prepare before the rains come.

sentences.zh: 若於黃、沁下南豫儲磚塊，則可有備無患。

translations.literal: If brick blocks are stockpiled south in Henan below the Yellow and Qin rivers, there will be provision without peril.
translations.idiomatic: Stockpiling brick blocks in south Henan below the Yellow and Qin rivers would leave us ready when trouble strikes.

sentences.zh: 應儲之磚，仍令向民間採買，不必廳員燒造，此外別無流弊。」

translations.literal: Bricks to be stored should still be bought from the populace; bureau officials need not fire kilns— beyond this there is no abuse."
translations.idiomatic: Stored brick should still be bought from local kilns, not fired by bureau staff— and beyond that there is no room for abuse."

sentences.zh: 卒如所議行。

translations.literal: In the end all was carried out as he proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The court finally adopted his plan in full.

sentences.zh: 遂請以四成辦稭之款改辦磚塊。

translations.literal: He then asked that forty percent of the straw-material fund be switched to brick blocks.
translations.idiomatic: He then proposed diverting forty percent of the straw-fascine budget to brick blocks.

sentences.zh: 又疏言：「從前治河用卷埽法，並有竹絡、木囷、磚石、柳葦。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Formerly river control used rolled fascines, along with bamboo cages, wooden cribs, brick and stone, and willow and reed.
translations.idiomatic: In another memorial he wrote: "River work once relied on rolled fascines, bamboo cages, wooden cribs, brick and stone, and willow and reed.

sentences.zh: 自用料鑲埽，以稭料為正宗，而險無定所，亦無一勞永逸之計。

translations.literal: Since material went to inset fascines with straw fascines as the orthodox method, danger has no fixed place and there is no once-for-all plan.
translations.idiomatic: Once inset fascines and straw fascines became the standard, danger shifted everywhere and no permanent fix remained.

sentences.zh: 緣鑲埽陡立，易激水怒。

translations.literal: Because inset fascines stand steep, they easily rouse the water's fury.
translations.idiomatic: Inset fascines rise too steeply and easily provoke the current.

sentences.zh: 其始水深不過數尺，鑲埽數段，引溜愈深，動輒數丈，無工變為險工。

translations.literal: At first depth is only a few chi; inset a few fascine sections and the drawn current deepens to several zhang— routine works become critical works.
translations.idiomatic: Where water was only a few feet deep, a few inset fascine sections drew the current down several zhang and turned routine stretches into emergencies.

sentences.zh: 溜勢上提，必須添鑲；

translations.literal: When the current trend lifts, more fascines must be added;
translations.idiomatic: When the current climbs, more fascines must be added;

sentences.zh: 溜勢下坐，必須接鑲。

translations.literal: when it sinks, fascines must be extended.
translations.idiomatic: when it drops, the line must be extended downstream.

sentences.zh: 片段愈長，防守愈難。

translations.literal: Sections grow longer and defense harder.
translations.idiomatic: Each extension makes the line harder to hold.

sentences.zh: 新工既生，益形勞費。

translations.literal: New works arise and toil and expense mount.
translations.idiomatic: Fresh emergencies multiply labor and cost.

sentences.zh: 埽工無法減少，不得已而減土工，少購碎石，皆為苟且因循之計。

translations.literal: Fascine work cannot be reduced; earth work is cut and less rubble bought— all makeshift procrastination.
translations.idiomatic: Because fascine work cannot be cut, officials trim earth work and buy less rubble stone— stopgaps that only postpone disaster.

sentences.zh: 自試拋磚壩，或用以杜新工，或用以護舊工，無不著有成效。

translations.literal: Since trial casts of brick dams— whether to stop new works or protect old— none have failed to show results.
translations.idiomatic: Since we began trial brick dams, whether to block new emergencies or shield old works, every case has paid off.

sentences.zh: 且磚工不特資經久，而堆儲亦無風火堪虞。

translations.literal: Brick works not only last, but stored piles need fear no wind or fire.
translations.idiomatic: Brick lasts, and stockpiles need not fear wind or fire.

sentences.zh: 從此工固瀾安，益复培增土工，專用力於根本之地，既可免漫溢之患，亦保無衝決之虞。」

translations.literal: Henceforth works firm and waves calm, earth works may be further built up, effort concentrated on fundamentals— flood overflow can be avoided and breach prevented."
translations.idiomatic: With works secure and the river quiet, we can rebuild earth embankments and spend on fundamentals— preventing both overflow and breach."

sentences.zh: 宣宗深嘉納之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong deeply praised and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong warmly approved.

sentences.zh: 巡撫牛鑑入覲，諭以毓美治河得手，遇事毋掣其肘。

translations.literal: Governor Niu Jian came to audience and was instructed that Yumei's river work was succeeding and on no account to hamstring him.
translations.idiomatic: When Governor Niu Jian came to court, he was told Yumei's river policy was working and warned not to interfere.

sentences.zh: 二十年，京察，特予議敘。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, at the capital evaluation, special merit rating was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he received a special merit rating at the capital evaluation.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，優詔褒惜，贈太子太保，依總督例賜卹，賜其子燿進士，諡恭勤，祀名宦祠。

translations.literal: Soon he died; a gracious edict mourned and praised him; he was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent; condolence payments followed the governor-general precedent; his son Yao was granted jinshi; posthumous name Gongqin; enshrined in the local worthies temple.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after. The throne mourned him in a gracious edict, posthumously made him Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, granted condolence payments on the governor-general scale, awarded his son Yao the jinshi degree, gave him the posthumous name Gongqin, and enshrined him in the local worthies temple.

sentences.zh: 毓美治河，風雨危險必躬親，河道曲折高下鄉背，皆所隱度。

translations.literal: In governing the river Yumei personally faced wind, rain, and danger; bends, elevations, and the facing of the channel he gauged in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Yumei met every storm and hazard in person, reading each bend, grade, and bank facing before the water arrived.

sentences.zh: 每曰：「水將抵某所，急備之。」

translations.literal: He would say: "Water will reach such-and-such a place— prepare at once."
translations.idiomatic: He would say: "The water will hit such-and-such a point— get ready now."

sentences.zh: 或以為迂且勞費，毓美曰：「能知費之為省，乃真能費者也。」

translations.literal: Some thought this fussy and wasteful; Yumei said: "To know that spending is saving— that is true spending."
translations.idiomatic: Others called it fussy and costly. Yumei replied: "Knowing when spending saves money is the only way to spend wisely."

sentences.zh: 水至，乃大服。

translations.literal: When the water came, all were deeply convinced.
translations.idiomatic: When the flood arrived, they were convinced.

sentences.zh: 在任五年，河不為患。

translations.literal: Five years in office— the river caused no trouble.
translations.idiomatic: During five years in office the river never broke out.

sentences.zh: 歿後吏民思慕，廟祀以為神，數著靈應，加封號，列入祀典。

translations.literal: After death officials and people mourned him; a temple enshrined him as a god; miracles were often reported; titles were added and he entered the official register of sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: After his death officials and commoners missed him; a temple raised him to divine status, miracles were reported, honors multiplied, and he entered the state sacrificial rolls.

sentences.zh: 麟慶，字見亭，完顏氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Lin Qing, style Jianting, of the Wanyan clan, was a Bannerman of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Qing, styled Jianting, of the Wanyan clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十四年進士，授內閣中書，遷兵部主事，改中允。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Jiaqing he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed Secretariat drafter; he was promoted to clerk in the Ministry of War and then changed to censor-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi of Jiaqing 14, he entered the Secretariat as a drafter, rose to a clerkship in the Ministry of War, and then became a censor-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，出為安徽徽州知府，調潁州，擢河南開歸陳許道。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daoguang he was sent out as prefect of Huizhou in Anhui, transferred to Yingzhou, and promoted intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu circuit in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 3 he became Huizhou prefect in Anhui, moved to Yingzhou, and was promoted to Henan's Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu intendant.

sentences.zh: 歷河南按察使、貴州布政使，護理巡撫。

translations.literal: He served successively as judicial commissioner of Henan, fiscal commissioner of Guizhou, and acting governor.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Henan judicial commissioner, Guizhou fiscal commissioner, and acting governor.

sentences.zh: 十三年，擢湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted governor of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he became governor of Hubei.

sentences.zh: 尋授江南河道總督，丁母憂，改署理，服闋，乃實授。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed governor-general of the Southern River course; when his mother died he served in an acting capacity, and after mourning ended received the substantive appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon named Southern River governor-general; after his mother's death he served in an acting post, and received the full appointment once mourning ended.

sentences.zh: 疏陳籌辦南河情形，略曰：「近年河湖交敝，欲復舊制，不外蓄清刷黃。

translations.literal: He memorialized on planning for the Southern River, in brief: "In recent years river and lakes have both decayed; to restore the old system nothing goes beyond storing clear water to scour the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In a memorial on Southern River policy he wrote: "River and lake alike have declined. Restoring the old order comes down to storing clear water to scour the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 古人引導清水，三分濟運，七分刷黃，得力在磨盤埽。

translations.literal: The ancients led clear water— three parts for transport, seven to scour the Yellow; the key lay in the Millstone fascines.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients sent clear water three parts to the canal and seven to scour the Yellow River, relying above all on the Millstone fascines.

sentences.zh: 自廢棄後，河務漸壞，擬規复磨盤埽舊制。

translations.literal: Since that system was abandoned river affairs have worsened; he proposed restoring the Millstone fascines.
translations.idiomatic: After it was abandoned river work slid downhill; I propose restoring the Millstone fascines.

sentences.zh: 洪澤湖水甚寬，高家堰工絕險，各壩多封柴土蓄水，盛漲啟放，輒壞壩底，糜費不貲。

translations.literal: Hongze Lake is very wide; Gaojia Embankment work is extremely perilous; many dams seal with brush and earth to store water— at peak rise opening them ruins the dam base at boundless cost.
translations.idiomatic: Hongze Lake spreads wide and the Gaojia Embankment is treacherous. Most dams are packed with brush and earth to hold water; opening them in flood season wrecks the foundations and wastes fortunes.

sentences.zh: 應仿滾水壩成法，抬高石底，至蓄水尺寸為度。

translations.literal: They should follow relief-dam precedent— raise the stone bed to the intended storage height.
translations.idiomatic: We should follow relief-dam practice: raise the stone bed to the height needed for storage.

sentences.zh: 山圩五壩暨下游楊河境內車邏等壩，一遵奏定丈尺啟放，水定即行堵合。

translations.literal: The five Shanwei dams and downstream dams such as Chexiang in Yanghe territory should open strictly according to memorialized measures; once water settles they should be sealed at once.
translations.idiomatic: Shanwei's five dams and downstream structures such as Chexiang in Yanghe should open only to the memorialized levels and be closed again as soon as the water drops.

sentences.zh: 至黃河各工，當體察平險，節可緩之埽段，辦緊要之土工。

translations.literal: As for Yellow River works, one should judge safe from perilous stretches, trim deferrable fascine sections, and carry out urgent earth work.
translations.idiomatic: On the Yellow River itself we should weigh safe against dangerous points, defer nonessential fascine work, and concentrate on critical earth repairs.

sentences.zh: 一切疏浚器具，祗備運河挑挖。

translations.literal: All dredging equipment should be kept only for Grand Canal excavation.
translations.idiomatic: Dredging gear should be reserved for the Grand Canal alone.

sentences.zh: 若黃河底淤，非人力所能強刷，惟儲備料工，遇險即搶，以防為治，而其要全在得人。

translations.literal: Yellow River silt on the bed cannot be forcibly scoured by human effort; one can only stock materials and labor, rush repairs when danger comes, treat defense as control— and the essential lies entirely in getting the right men.
translations.idiomatic: Silt on the Yellow River bed cannot be scoured away by manpower alone. We can only stock materials and crews, rush repairs when danger appears, and treat prevention as policy— but success depends on having the right officials.

sentences.zh: 又以蘆葦為工程必需，右營盪地荒廢，產蘆不足，請築圩蓄水以資灌溉。」

translations.literal: Reeds are also essential to the works; Right Garrison shoal lands lie waste and reed supply is insufficient— he asked to build polders to store water for irrigation."
translations.idiomatic: Reeds are indispensable to the works, yet the Right Garrison shoals lie idle and supply is short; he asked to build polders to store water and restore reed farming."

sentences.zh: 疏入，詔嘉其言正當，勗慎勉從事。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, an edict praised his words as sound and urged careful, diligent service.
translations.idiomatic: The throne praised the memorial as sound and urged him to proceed carefully.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以洪澤湖老子山西北挑砌石壩，東西沙路加築碎石，高出湖面，以便水師巡哨及商民停泊，疏請淮海、常鎮等道另案用銀。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, northwest of Laozi Mountain on Hongze Lake, a stone dam was built by excavation and masonry; east and west sand paths were topped with rubble stone above lake level to facilitate naval patrol and merchant mooring; he memorialized asking the Huai-Hai, Chang-Zhen, and other circuits to fund it under a separate account.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he built a stone dam northwest of Laozi Mountain on Hongze Lake and raised east and west sand paths with rubble stone above lake level so patrol boats and merchant craft could moor. He asked the Huai-Hai, Chang-Zhen, and other circuits to fund it separately.

sentences.zh: 詔以南河連歲安瀾，而工用日增，切責之。

translations.literal: An edict sharply rebuked him: though the Southern River had been calm year after year, project costs kept rising daily.
translations.idiomatic: The throne rebuked him sharply: the Southern River had stayed calm for years, yet costs kept climbing.

sentences.zh: 十九年，修惠濟正閘、福興越閘。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the Huiji main sluice and Fuxing oversluice were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he repaired the Huiji main sluice and the Fuxing oversluice.

sentences.zh: 會河湖並漲，險工疊生，請例外撥銀五十萬，詔允之，戒嗣後不得援例。

translations.literal: When lake and river both rose and critical works piled up one upon another, he asked for an exceptional allocation of five hundred thousand taels; the edict approved but warned that precedent must not be cited afterward.
translations.idiomatic: When lake and river rose together and emergencies multiplied, he requested an exceptional five hundred thousand taels. The court granted it but warned against citing the case again.

sentences.zh: 署兩江總督。

translations.literal: He served as acting governor-general of the Two Jiangs.
translations.idiomatic: He acted as governor-general of the Two Jiangs.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，河決祥符，黃水匯注洪澤湖，南河無事，詔嘉其化險為夷，予議敘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year the river breached at Xiangfu; Yellow River water poured into Hongze Lake; the Southern River was unharmed; an edict praised him for turning peril to ease and granted merit rating.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year the river broke at Xiangfu and Yellow River water flooded into Hongze Lake, yet the Southern River held. The throne praised him for turning danger into safety and granted a merit rating.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，英吉利兵艦入江，命籌淮、揚防務以保運道，請以鹽運使但明倫備防揚州，以清江為後路策應，捕內匪陳三虎等誅之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year English warships entered the river; he was ordered to plan Huai-Yang defenses to protect the transport route; he asked that Salt Transport Commissioner Dan Minglun guard Yangzhou with Qingjiang as rear support; bandits Chen Sanhu and others were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year British warships entered the Yangzi. Ordered to organize Huai-Yang defenses for the transport route, he put Salt Transport Commissioner Dan Minglun in charge at Yangzhou with Qingjiang as a fallback and had the bandit Chen Sanhu and his followers captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 秋，河決桃北崔鎮汛，值漕船回空，改由中河灌塘，通行無誤，詔念防務及濟運勞，革職，免罪。

translations.literal: That autumn the river breached at the Cuizhen station north of Taobei; returning grain barges were on the empty voyage; the route was changed to middle-channel pond filling; passage was unimpeded; an edict noted his labors in defense and transport, stripped him of office, and waived punishment.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the river broke at Cuizhen station north of Taobei while the grain fleet was returning empty. He shifted traffic through the middle route and filled ponds to keep boats moving without delay. The throne acknowledged his defense and transport work, removed him from office, and spared further punishment.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，發東河中牟工效力，工竣，以四品京堂候補。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was sent to serve meritoriously at the Zhongmou works on the Eastern River; when the project was finished he awaited appointment as a fourth-rank capital official.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was sent to atone through service at Zhongmou on the Eastern River; when the work ended he awaited appointment as a fourth-rank capital official.

sentences.zh: 尋予二等侍衛，充庫倫辦事大臣，乞病未行。

translations.literal: Soon he was granted second-rank imperial guardsman and appointed commissioner at Kuren; he pleaded illness and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made a second-rank imperial guardsman and named Kuren commissioner, but pleaded illness and never took up the post.

sentences.zh: 病痊，仍改四品京堂。

translations.literal: When his illness healed he was still changed to fourth-rank capital official.
translations.idiomatic: After he recovered he was again listed as a fourth-rank capital official.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after.

sentences.zh: 著有黃運河口古今圖說、河工器具圖說。

translations.literal: He authored Illustrated Accounts of the Yellow and Transport River Mouths, Ancient and Modern, and Illustrated Accounts of River-Engineering Implements.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote Illustrated Accounts of the Yellow and Transport River Mouths, Ancient and Modern, and Illustrated Accounts of River-Engineering Implements.

sentences.zh: 子崇實、崇厚，並自有傳。

translations.literal: His sons Chongshi and Chonghou each have separate biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Chongshi and Chonghou are each treated in separate biographies.

sentences.zh: 潘錫恩，字芸閣，安徽涇縣人。

translations.literal: Pan Xien, styled Yunge, was a native of Jing County, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Xien, styled Yunge, came from Jing County in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十六年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: A jinshi of Jiaqing 16, he was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed compiling editor.
translations.idiomatic: Named jinshi in Jiaqing 16, he entered the Hanlin Academy as a probationary academician and became a compiling editor.

sentences.zh: 大考第一，超擢侍讀。

translations.literal: First in the triennial palace examination, he was specially promoted to reader-in-waiting.
translations.idiomatic: He placed first in the palace examination and was promoted directly to reader-in-waiting.

sentences.zh: 道光四年，復大考一等，擢侍讀學士。

translations.literal: In Daoguang 4, again first class in the triennial examination, he was promoted to reader of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 4 he again ranked first in the palace examination and was made a reader of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 時河患急，錫恩上疏條陳河務，略曰：「蓄清敵黃，為相傳成法。

translations.literal: River crisis was urgent; Xien memorialized with a detailed account of river affairs, stating in summary: "Storing clear water to repel Yellow water is the transmitted established method.
translations.idiomatic: With the river in crisis, Xien submitted a detailed memorial on river policy. In essence: "Holding clear water to counter Yellow water is the method handed down through generations.

sentences.zh: 大汛將至，急堵禦黃壩，使黃水全力東趨。

translations.literal: Great flood season approaching, the Yellow-blocking dam must be sealed urgently so Yellow water may run east with full force.
translations.idiomatic: When the great flood season nears, seal the Yellow-blocking dam at once so the Yellow River can run east unimpeded.

sentences.zh: 今年漕艘早渡，因禦黃壩遲堵，以致倒灌停淤，釀成大患。

translations.literal: This year grain barges crossed early; because the Yellow-blocking dam was sealed late, backflow and stopped silt ensued, brewing a great calamity.
translations.idiomatic: This year the grain fleet crossed early, but because the Yellow-blocking dam was closed late, backflow and silt deposits piled up into a major disaster.

sentences.zh: 且欲籌減洩，當在下游，乃輒開祥符徬，減黃入湖。

translations.literal: Moreover, if one wishes to plan discharge reduction, it should be downstream— yet they repeatedly opened the Xiangfu spillway, reducing Yellow into the lake.
translations.idiomatic: If we mean to relieve pressure, that should happen downstream— yet the Xiangfu spillway was opened again and again to divert Yellow water into the lake.

sentences.zh: 壩口已灌於下，徬口復灌於上，黃水俱無出路，湖底淤墊極高。

translations.literal: The dam mouth already poured in from below and the spillway mouth poured in from above; Yellow water had no outlet at all; lake-bottom silt rose extremely high.
translations.idiomatic: Water poured in below at the dam and above at the spillway until the Yellow River had nowhere to go and the lake bottom silted up to extraordinary heights.

sentences.zh: 若更引黃入運，河道淤滿，處處壅溢，恐有決口之患。」

translations.literal: If Yellow is further led into the Grand Canal, the channel will silt full; overflow will occur everywhere— I fear breach disaster."
translations.idiomatic: If we also draw Yellow water into the Grand Canal, the channel will choke with silt, overflows will break out everywhere, and breaches will follow."

sentences.zh: 宣宗韙其議。

translations.literal: The Xuanzong Emperor endorsed his views.
translations.idiomatic: The Daoguang Emperor endorsed his analysis.

sentences.zh: 五年，命以道員發往南河，補淮揚道。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered dispatched to the Southern River as a circuit intendant, filling the Huai-Yang circuit post.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was sent to the Southern River as a circuit intendant and appointed to the Huai-Yang circuit.

sentences.zh: 六年，加三品頂戴，授南河副總河。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he received third-rank court beads and was appointed vice commissioner of the Southern River.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he received third-rank insignia and was made vice commissioner of the Southern River.

sentences.zh: 九年，母憂去官，服闋，授光祿寺卿。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he left office for his mother's mourning; when mourning ended he was appointed minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he resigned for his mother's mourning. After the mourning period he became minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 歷宗人府府丞、左副都御史，督順天學政。

translations.literal: He served as vice director of the Imperial Clan Court and left vice censor-in-chief, supervising Shuntian education commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as vice director of the Imperial Clan Court and left vice censor-in-chief, and supervised as Shuntian education commissioner.

sentences.zh: 擢兵部侍郎，調吏部，仍留學政。

translations.literal: Promoted to vice minister of War, transferred to Personnel, he still retained the education commissionership.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to vice minister of War and transferred to Personnel, he kept the education commissionership.

sentences.zh: 十九年，內監狄文學以甥考試被黜，至錫恩私宅言所取錄多出請託，挾制訛詐，錫恩疏聞，特詔論文學大辟。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year the eunuch Di Wenxue, whose nephew was failed in the examination, came to Xien's private residence claiming most admissions came from requests for favors; he extorted and blackmailed; Xien memorialized; a special edict sentenced Wenxue to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year the eunuch Di Wenxue came to Xien's home after his nephew failed the examination, claiming most successful candidates owed their places to favor-seeking and trying to extort him. Xien reported the matter, and an imperial edict condemned Wenxue to death.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，疏言：「黃河自桃北崔鎮汛、蕭家莊北決口穿運河，壞遙堤，歸入六塘河東注。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he memorialized: "The Yellow River from Cuizhen station north of Taobei and Xiajiazhuang north breached through the Grand Canal, broke the outer dike, and entered Liutang River running east.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he wrote: "The Yellow River broke north of Cuizhen station at Taobei and north of Xiajiazhuang, cut through the Grand Canal, destroyed the outer embankment, and poured east into the Liutang River.

sentences.zh: 正河自揚工以下斷流，去清口約有六七十里之遠，回空漕船，阻於宿遷以上。

translations.literal: The main channel from the Yangzhou works downward was cut off— about sixty or seventy li from Qingkou; returning empty grain barges were blocked above Suqian.
translations.idiomatic: The main channel below the Yangzhou works ran dry some sixty or seventy li short of Qingkou, and returning empty grain barges were stuck above Suqian.

sentences.zh: 臣前任淮揚道時，詳辨戽水通船之法，行之十餘年，幸無貽誤。

translations.literal: When I formerly served as Huai-Yang intendant, I carefully distinguished the method of scooping water to pass boats; practiced more than ten years— fortunately without mishap.
translations.idiomatic: When I was Huai-Yang intendant I worked out a pond-filling method to lift water for boats. We used it for more than ten years without disaster.

sentences.zh: 今若於中河西口外築箝口壩，添設草徬，以為黃水啟閉之用，即將楊家壩作攔清堰，以為清水啟閉之用。

translations.literal: Now if at the west mouth of the middle channel we build a clamping dam outside, add brush spillways for opening and closing Yellow water, and make Yangjia Dam a clear-water barrier for opening and closing clear water—
translations.idiomatic: Build a clamping dam outside the west mouth of the middle channel and add brush spillways to control Yellow water; turn Yangjia Dam into a clear-water weir to control the clear flow.

sentences.zh: 就中河運道為一大塘，道里長則容船眾，兩次啟閉，漕船可以全渡。

translations.literal: — taking the middle-channel transport route as one great pond; with a long reach it holds many boats; twice opening and closing, grain barges can all cross.
translations.idiomatic: Treat the middle route as one long pond. The longer the reach, the more boats it holds; two rounds of opening and closing would carry the entire grain fleet across.

sentences.zh: 惟黃水先已灌入運河，中泓淤墊，兩岸纖堤亦恐有衝缺，趕緊修濬，計需費亦不甚多。

translations.literal: Only Yellow water has already poured into the Grand Canal; the central deep channel is silted; slender dikes on both banks also fear washouts— dredge urgently; estimated cost is not very great.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow water has already flooded the Grand Canal, the main channel is silted, and the narrow banks may have breached; dredging is urgent, but the cost should not be large.

sentences.zh: 此時果可回空。

translations.literal: At this time returning empty can indeed be accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: That would allow the returning fleet to pass now.

sentences.zh: 來年即可出重，則蕭莊決口不妨從緩堵築。

translations.literal: Next year heavy transport can go out; then the Xiaozhuang breach need not be blocked in haste.
translations.idiomatic: Next year's northbound grain could follow, and the Xiaozhuang breach could wait.

sentences.zh: 儻此法趕辦不及，祗有竟用引黃濟運之法。

translations.literal: If this method cannot be rushed in time, there is only the method of leading Yellow to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: If we cannot finish that plan in time, we must fall back on drawing Yellow water to aid transport.

sentences.zh: 其臨黃箝口壩草徬照式築作，引黃水入壩送船，沿途多築對頭小壩，以偪溜刷深，庶免淤滯之患。

translations.literal: Build Yellow-facing clamping dams and brush spillways after the same model, lead Yellow water into the dam to send boats; build many facing small dams along the route to force the current and scour deep, thereby avoiding silt stagnation.
translations.idiomatic: Build matching Yellow-facing clamping dams and brush spillways, let Yellow water into the pond to float the boats, and erect opposing small dams along the route to force the current and scour the channel deep, avoiding silt buildup.

sentences.zh: 迨出楊莊，匯入清河之水，即可牽挽南行。

translations.literal: Once past Yangzhuang, merging with Qing River water, boats can be towed southward.
translations.idiomatic: Once boats pass Yangzhuang and meet the Qing River, they can be towed south.

sentences.zh: 蓋南岸不可藉黃者，恐其淤湖淤運。

translations.literal: The reason the south bank cannot rely on Yellow is fear of silting lake and silting canal.
translations.idiomatic: The south bank cannot use Yellow water because it would silt both lake and canal.

sentences.zh: 今所引黃水，一出楊莊口，仍歸舊河，自可用清口之水以刷滌之，應無流弊。」

translations.literal: The Yellow water now led— once out Yangzhuang mouth, still returns to the old river— can naturally be scoured with Qingkou water; presumably no lasting harm."
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow water we propose would leave at Yangzhuang, rejoin the old channel, and be scoured clean with water from Qingkou; it should leave no lasting damage."

sentences.zh: 並以圖說進，下河督麟慶議行。

translations.literal: He also submitted illustrated plans; the case was sent to river governor Lin Qing for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted illustrated plans as well, and the memorial went to river governor Lin Qing, who approved it for action.

sentences.zh: 麟慶亦主用灌塘法，與錫恩言合，尋代麟慶為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: Lin Qing also favored the pond-filling method, agreeing with Xien's words; soon he replaced Lin Qing as governor-general of the Jiangnan river course.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Qing also advocated pond irrigation for transport and agreed with Xien; Xien soon replaced him as Jiangnan river governor-general.

sentences.zh: 時揚工漫溢，尚書敬徵等查勘，堵築決口，開挖引河，接挑長河淤墊，估銀五百七十萬兩有奇。

translations.literal: At the time the Yangzhou works overflowed; Minister Jingzheng and others inspected; blocking the breach, digging diversion channels, dredging long-reach silt was estimated at more than five million seven hundred thousand taels.
translations.idiomatic: The Yangzhou works were overflowing. Minister Jingzheng and others surveyed the site: blocking the breach, cutting diversion channels, and dredging the long channel would cost more than 5.7 million taels.

sentences.zh: 御史雷以諴奏決口無庸堵合，祗須改舊河為支河，以通運道而節糜費，下錫恩會議。

translations.literal: Censor Lei Yixin memorialized that the breach need not be blocked— only change the old river into a branch channel to connect the transport route and save waste; the case was sent to Xien for conference.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Lei Yixin argued the breach should not be closed— turn the old channel into a branch to serve transport and save money. The court referred the matter to Xien.

sentences.zh: 錫恩奏覆：「灌口非可行河之地，北岸無可改河之理，請仍堵築決口。

translations.literal: Xien memorialized in reply: "Guankou is not terrain where a river can run; the north bank has no rationale for changing the river— I ask still to block the breach.
translations.idiomatic: Xien replied: "Guankou cannot carry a river, and there is no sound way to reroute on the north bank. The breach should still be closed.

sentences.zh: 漕船回空，仍由中河灌塘。」

translations.literal: Returning empty grain barges should still use middle-channel pond filling."
translations.idiomatic: Returning grain barges should still pass through the middle route by pond filling."

sentences.zh: 命侍郎成剛、府尹李僡赴工會同錫恩督辦。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Cheng Gang and Prefect Li Bin were ordered to the works to supervise jointly with Xien.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Cheng Gang and Prefect Li Bin were sent to the site to supervise the work with Xien.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，夫工以下挑河四萬一百九十餘丈，工竣，啟除界壩，放水通暢。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, below Fugong more than forty-one thousand nine hundred zhang of channel was dredged; when works finished the boundary dam was opened and removed; water flowed unimpeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year more than 41,900 zhang of channel below Fugong was dredged. When the work ended the boundary dam was removed and water ran freely.

sentences.zh: 會河南中牟河決，黃水注湖，請放山盱各壩宣洩湖水，並將夫工導出湖水，引入中河，暫濟鹽柴轉運。

translations.literal: When Henan Zhongmou river breached and Yellow water poured into the lake, he asked to open Shan-Xu dams to discharge lake water, and also to lead lake water out from Fugong into the middle channel to aid salt-and-firewood transport temporarily.
translations.idiomatic: When the river broke at Zhongmou in Henan and Yellow water flooded the lake, he asked to open the Shan-Xu dams to release lake water, channel it from Fugong into the middle route, and temporarily sustain salt and firewood transport.

sentences.zh: 復以上游河水陡落，間有淤墊，請改估蕭工以下未挑之工，並挑築大堤單薄卑矮處。

translations.literal: Again, because upstream river water dropped sharply with occasional silt buildup, he asked to re-estimate undredged work below Xiaogong and dredge and build where the great dike was thin, low, and weak.
translations.idiomatic: Upstream water had fallen sharply and silt had begun to collect again; he asked to revise estimates for undredged work below Xiaogong and rebuild stretches where the main dike was thin and low.

sentences.zh: 是秋，湖水接長，掣卸高堰石工四千餘丈，搶護未決。

translations.literal: That autumn lake water rose continuously; more than four thousand zhang of Gaoya stone work was torn away; emergency defense held without breach.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the lake kept rising. More than 4,000 zhang of stone work on the high weir gave way, but emergency repairs held the line.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，黃流未復故道，急籌濟運，並宣洩湖水，請啟放外南廳屬順清河，導引入河歸海。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the Yellow current had not returned to its old course; urgently planning transport aid and discharging lake water, he asked to open Shunqing River under the Outer South office and lead it into the river to reach the sea.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year the Yellow River had not returned to its old channel. To sustain transport and drain the lake, he asked to open Shunqing River under the Outer South bureau and channel it to the sea.

sentences.zh: 軍船抵壩，即由其處放渡，並於外南之北攔黃壩址築鉗口土壩，以資停蓄。

translations.literal: When military boats reached the dam they would cross there; north of Outer South at the Yellow-blocking dam site a clamping earth dam would be built for storage.
translations.idiomatic: Military boats would cross as soon as they reached the dam; north of Outer South an earthen clamping dam would be built on the old Yellow-blocking site to hold back water.

sentences.zh: 尋奏：「黃河上游六月間陡長水丈餘，山盱林家西壩、舊義河直壩、及仁義河中間攔堰，間有掣塌，補修完密。

translations.literal: Soon he memorialized: "In June the Yellow River upstream rose sharply more than one zhang; Shan-Xu Linjia West Dam, Old Yihe Straight Dam, and the middle barrier on Renyi River each partly collapsed; repairs restored them tight.
translations.idiomatic: He soon reported: "In June upstream Yellow River levels surged more than a zhang. The Linjia West dam at Shan-Xu, the Old Yihe straight dam, and the middle weir on the Renyi River all partly failed; repairs made them sound again.

sentences.zh: 裡、河、揚三廳承受洪湖之水，兩岸纖堤舊有護埽者，致多刷蟄，亦擇要加鑲。」

translations.literal: The Li, He, and Yang three offices receive Hong Lake water; slender banks on both sides that formerly had fascine protection suffered much scour and sinkage; key points were also selected for reinforcement."
translations.idiomatic: The Li, He, and Yang bureaus take Hong Lake water. Narrow banks that once had fascine protection had scoured badly; critical stretches were reinforced."

sentences.zh: 二十五年，中牟工始合龍，南河連年無險。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year the Zhongmou works were first closed; the Southern River had no peril year after year.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year the Zhongmou project closed. The Southern River stayed free of crisis for years on end.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以病乞歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he begged leave to retire on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year he retired because of illness.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，命在籍治捐輸團練。

translations.literal: In the Xianfeng era he was ordered at home to manage donation drives and militia training.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng reign he was ordered to organize donations and local militia at home.

sentences.zh: 八年，前江西巡撫張芾劾其勸捐無狀，褫職。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the former Jiangxi governor Zhang Fu impeached him for disgraceful conduct in soliciting donations; his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year former Jiangxi governor Zhang Fu impeached him for misconduct in soliciting donations, and he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，捐京倉米折，復原銜，命赴安徽廬州會辦勸捐守禦事。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi 3, donating grain cash equivalent for Beijing granaries, his original rank was restored; he was ordered to Luzhou, Anhui to jointly manage donation and defense affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 he donated grain cash for the Beijing granaries, had his original rank restored, and was sent to Luzhou in Anhui to help organize donations and local defense.

sentences.zh: 五年，鄉舉重逢，加太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, upon the provincial examination's anniversary reunion, he was given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the anniversary of his provincial examination success, he received the title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth year.

sentences.zh: 漕運總督張之萬疏陳錫恩治績，賜祭葬，諡文慎，入祀鄉賢祠。

translations.literal: Grain Transport Governor-General Zhang Zhiwan memorialized Xien's governance achievements; sacrificial rites and burial honors were granted; posthumous name Wenshen; entry into the local worthies shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Grain Transport Governor-General Zhang Zhiwan memorialized Xien's record in office. The court granted funeral honors, gave the posthumous name Wenshen, and enshrined him in the local worthies hall.

sentences.zh: 子駿文，入貲為刑部郎中，改山東知府。

translations.literal: His son Junwen purchased office as a Bureau of Punishments director, then shifted to Shandong prefect.
translations.idiomatic: His son Junwen bought an appointment as a director in the Ministry of Justice and later became prefect of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 咸豐末，捻匪犯省城，駿文率兵團迎擊於段家店，卻之。

translations.literal: Late in Xianfeng the Nian bandits attacked the provincial capital; Junwen led militia to meet them at Duandian and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Xianfeng reign Nian bandits threatened the provincial capital. Junwen led local militia against them at Duandian and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 署青州，平淄川鳳皇山土匪，擢道員。

translations.literal: Acting at Qingzhou, he pacified bandits at Fenghuang Mountain, Zichuan, and was promoted to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: While acting at Qingzhou he suppressed bandits on Fenghuang Mountain in Zichuan and was promoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 同治中，巡撫閻敬銘、丁寶楨皆倚之。

translations.literal: In the Tongzhi era Governors Yan Jingming and Ding Baozhen both relied on him.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi reign both Governors Yan Jingming and Ding Baozhen leaned heavily on him.

sentences.zh: 從寶楨會剿捻匪，塞河侯家林，功尤多，授兗沂曹道。

translations.literal: Following Baozhen in joint suppression of Nian bandits, blocking the river at Houjialin— his merit was especially great; he was appointed Yan-Yi-Cao intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Serving under Baozhen against the Nian, he blocked the river at Houjialin and won especially high credit; he was made Yan-Yi-Cao intendant.

sentences.zh: 光緒中，遷按察使。

translations.literal: In the Guangxu era he was transferred to judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Under Guangxu he became judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 坐事降調，以諳習河事，仍留山東。

translations.literal: Demoted and reassigned for an offense; because he was skilled in river affairs he remained in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: After a demotion for misconduct he stayed in Shandong because of his river expertise.

sentences.zh: 歷治上下游要工，調河南鄭工，專任西壩，以合龍愆期，革職留工，工竣，復原官。

translations.literal: He successively managed critical upstream and downstream works; transferred to Henan Zheng works, solely responsible for the west dam; because closure was delayed he was stripped of office but kept at the works; when works finished his original rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: He handled critical works up and down the river, then went to the Zhengzhou project in Henan in charge of the west dam. When the closure ran late he was dismissed but kept on site; when the work ended his rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 授山西按察使，護理巡撫，遷福建布政使。

translations.literal: Appointed Shanxi judicial commissioner, acting governor, transferred to Fujian fiscal commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He became Shanxi judicial commissioner and acting governor, then moved to Fujian as fiscal commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十九年，卒於官。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office in the nineteenth year.

sentences.zh: 山東士民以其治河功，請建專祠。

translations.literal: Shandong gentry and people, for his river-governance merit, asked to build a dedicated shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong scholars and commoners asked for a shrine in his honor for his river work.

sentences.zh: 論曰：河患至道光朝而愈亟，南河為漕運所累，愈治愈壞。

translations.literal: The critique states: River calamity to the Daoguang reign grew ever more urgent; the Southern River, burdened by grain transport, worsened the more it was treated.
translations.idiomatic: The historians observe: By the Daoguang reign river crisis had grown acute. The Southern River, chained to the grain transport, only deteriorated under repeated repairs.

sentences.zh: 自張文浩蓄清肇禍，高堰決而運道阻。

translations.literal: Since Zhang Wenhao's storing clear water began the disaster, Gaoya breached and the transport route was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Since Zhang Wenhao's policy of holding clear water set disaster in motion, the Gaoya breach had blocked the transport route.

sentences.zh: 嚴烺畏首畏尾，湖河並不能治。

translations.literal: Yan Lang was timid at both ends; lake and river alike he could not govern.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Lang vacillated at every turn and mastered neither lake nor river.

sentences.zh: 張井創議改河，而不敢執咎，迄於無成，灌塘濟運，賴以彌縫。

translations.literal: Zhang Jing pioneered the proposal to change the river but did not dare bear blame; in the end nothing was achieved; pond filling to aid transport alone patched the gaps.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jing proposed rerouting the river but would not accept responsibility; the plan came to nothing. Pond irrigation for transport alone kept the system patched together.

sentences.zh: 麟慶、潘錫恩循其成法，幸無大敗而已。

translations.literal: Lin Qing and Pan Xien followed its established method— fortunately without great failure, and no more.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Qing and Pan Xien followed that established practice and were lucky to avoid outright catastrophe— and nothing more.

sentences.zh: 吳邦慶講求水利，而治河未有顯績。

translations.literal: Wu Bangqing studied water control, yet in river governance had no conspicuous achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bangqing studied water management but achieved nothing conspicuous in river work.

sentences.zh: 栗毓美實心實力，卓為當時河臣之冠，不獨磚工創法為可紀也。

translations.literal: Li Yumei with honest heart and honest strength stood foremost among river officials of the time— not only his brick-work innovation deserves record.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yumei worked with genuine dedication and stood head and shoulders above the river officials of his day—not only for inventing brick works.

sentences.zh: 東河自毓美後，硃襄、鍾祥、文沖繼之，祥符、中牟迭決，東河遂益棘矣。

translations.literal: On the Eastern River after Yumei, Zhu Xiang, Zhong Xiang, and Wen Chong succeeded in turn; Xiangfu and Zhongmou breached in succession; the Eastern River grew ever more perilous.
translations.idiomatic: After Yumei on the Eastern River came Zhu Xiang, Zhong Xiang, and Wen Chong in turn. Breaks at Xiangfu and Zhongmou followed one another, and the Eastern River grew steadily more dangerous.
